_meta.note: 一個任務一個檔。改完跑 tools/quest-bundle.py。

Echoes of Change#000.src: Attend the meeting to prepare for the plan in the Steel Feather at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#002.src: I trust everyone has taken the time to process last night's announcement? I will let Syndra take over shortly, but first, I would like to thank each and every one of you.
Echoes of Change#002.dst: 我相信大家都花了時間消化昨晚的宣布？我等一下就把場子交給 Syndra，不過首先，我想謝謝你們每一個人。
Echoes of Change#002.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#003.src: I won't mince words. This is dangerous work. What we are planning puts us at great risk. But this is what it takes to change Fruma, to put an end to the crown's oppression!
Echoes of Change#003.dst: 我不繞圈子。這是危險的工作。我們計畫的事把我們置於極大的風險之中。但要改變 Fruma、要終結王室的壓迫，就得付出這個代價！
Echoes of Change#003.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#004.src: We will kill a God! And we will all be free. Now, Syndra?
Echoes of Change#004.dst: 我們要弒神！我們所有人都將獲得自由。那麼，Syndra？
Echoes of Change#004.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#005.src: Thank you, Quill. To begin, allow me to give each group their assignment.
Echoes of Change#005.dst: 謝謝你，Quill。首先，容我把各組的任務分派下去。
Echoes of Change#005.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#006.src: Mora and Yuman, you will be infiltrating the guards' outpost in {p} to retrieve their schedules. Get in, note down the formations, and get out.
Echoes of Change#006.dst: Mora 和 Yuman，你們去潛入 {p} 的衛兵哨站，取得他們的排班表。進去，把配置記下來，然後出來。
Echoes of Change#006.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#007.src: Mora, you're familiar with military structure, and Yuman knows his way around {p}. I expect you two should be able to make it work.
Echoes of Change#007.dst: Mora，你熟悉軍隊的編制；Yuman 熟悉 {p} 的路。我相信你們兩個辦得到。
Echoes of Change#007.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#009.src: Understood. However, I have a few concerns with the overall plans... I'll speak with you later.
Echoes of Change#009.dst: 明白。不過我對整體計畫有幾點疑慮……我晚點再跟你談。
Echoes of Change#009.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#010.src: Yusanu and Sui, you'll be constructing explosives that we can use as distractions during the festival to draw guards away from the main stage.
Echoes of Change#010.dst: Yusanu 和 Sui，你們負責製作炸藥，慶典期間我們要用它們製造騷動，把衛兵從主舞台引開。
Echoes of Change#010.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#011.src: I trust Yusanu knows what he's doing, so Sui, you'll be acting as an assistant.
Echoes of Change#011.dst: 我相信 Yusanu 知道自己在做什麼，所以 Sui，你擔任助手。
Echoes of Change#011.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#013.src: Works for me. I might already have some blueprints lying around somewhere...
Echoes of Change#013.dst: 我沒問題。我大概還有一些設計圖放在哪裡……
Echoes of Change#013.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#014.src: Zeph and Rex, I want you to scout the city rooftops for potential spots where Rex and Yulie can provide aerial support... in case it's necessary.
Echoes of Change#014.dst: Zeph 和 Rex，我要你們去勘查城裡的屋頂，找出 Rex 和 Yulie 可以提供空中支援的位置……以防真的需要。
Echoes of Change#014.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#015.src: Yeah, I c- c- can do that.
Echoes of Change#015.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#017.src: Quill and Yulie, you two know your way around the city. I'll need you to scout out potential escape routes from the city... again, in case things go badly.
Echoes of Change#017.dst: Quill 和 Yulie，你們兩個熟這座城。我需要你們去勘查可能的撤離路線……同樣是，以防情況變糟。
Echoes of Change#017.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#018.src: Ah, that should be a breeze.
Echoes of Change#018.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#019.src: ...yes. I think I have a few places in mind already.
Echoes of Change#019.dst: ……好。我心裡已經有幾個地方了。
Echoes of Change#019.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#020.src: Finally. {u}, I want you to be adaptable. Help out wherever it's needed - I'm sure your skills will come in handy.
Echoes of Change#020.dst: 最後。{u}，我要你保持機動。哪裡需要就去哪裡幫忙——我相信你的本事會很有用。
Echoes of Change#020.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#021.src: Hey, if you're helping out wherever, you should come with me and Mora! Guard positions would be handy to know before finding escape routes.
Echoes of Change#021.dst: 嘿，既然你哪裡都能幫，那就跟我和 Mora 一起吧！在找撤離路線之前，先知道衛兵的位置會很有幫助。
Echoes of Change#021.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#022.src: I was about to suggest the same thing. Then let us adjourn this meeting. Good luck, everyone.
Echoes of Change#022.dst: 我正要提同樣的建議。那麼會議就到此為止。祝各位好運。
Echoes of Change#022.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#023.src: Hum. {u} and Yuman, let us go our plans then.
Echoes of Change#023.dst: 嗯。{u}、Yuman，那我們來談談我們的計畫吧。
Echoes of Change#023.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#024.src: Meet up with Mora and Yuman at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#024.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Mora 和 Yuman 會合。

Echoes of Change#025.src: Alright, guys! So, any plans? What're we cooking with here?
Echoes of Change#025.dst: 好啦，各位！所以呢，有什麼計畫？我們手上有什麼料？
Echoes of Change#025.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#027.src: Hey, man, everything good? I'm uh, not that horrible to work with, am I? Haha.
Echoes of Change#027.dst: 嘿，老兄，還好嗎？我，呃，沒有那麼難合作吧？哈哈。
Echoes of Change#027.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#028.src: Ah! My apologies. No, it is not you... I simply do not like Syndra's plan.
Echoes of Change#028.dst: 啊！抱歉。不，不是你的問題……我只是不喜歡 Syndra 的計畫。
Echoes of Change#028.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#029.src: You must understand, I would trust her with my life... but that is precisely the issue. She will do anything to avoid putting us in danger.
Echoes of Change#029.dst: 你要明白，我願意把命交到她手上……但問題正是出在這裡。她會不惜一切避免讓我們涉險。
Echoes of Change#029.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#030.src: She treats us as her own children, but she is only a decade older than I am! She would put herself through all the suffering in the world, if only to avoid letting us help where it is most needed!
Echoes of Change#030.dst: 她把我們當成自己的孩子，可她也不過大我十歲！只要能不讓我們在最需要的地方幫上忙，她願意把世上所有的苦難都往自己身上攬！
Echoes of Change#030.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#031.src: She is willing to take the fall if the plan goes awry. But, this time... this time, I will not back off. I am not allowing her to put herself through that danger alone.
Echoes of Change#031.dst: 萬一計畫出了差錯，她願意獨自承擔。但這一次……這一次，我不會退開。我不會讓她一個人去冒那個險。
Echoes of Change#031.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#032.src: Yeesh. Didn't think you guys were that messy! I think I get it though.
Echoes of Change#032.dst: 唉喲。沒想到你們的關係這麼糾結！不過我想我懂。
Echoes of Change#032.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#033.src: My bros... they mean well, yeah, but they never ask for help. They're always trying to do everything themselves, and... and it drives me nuts!
Echoes of Change#033.dst: 我那幾個哥哥……他們是好意，沒錯，可是他們從來不開口求助。他們老想把每件事都自己扛，然後……然後這快把我逼瘋了！
Echoes of Change#033.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#034.src: Like, man, just let me do something!! Anything!! It's so frustrating.
Echoes of Change#034.dst: 拜託，老兄，就讓我做點什麼啊！！什麼都好！！真的很讓人抓狂。
Echoes of Change#034.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#035.src: Ha! I did not think we had this in common. Well then... perhaps we can both prove ourselves to our families, eh?
Echoes of Change#035.dst: 哈！我沒想到我們有這個共同點。那麼……也許我們都能向自己的家人證明點什麼，嗯？
Echoes of Change#035.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#036.src: Yeah!! I like the sound of that!!
Echoes of Change#036.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#037.src: Okay, well, I know where the guards' outpost is in {p}. Let's just go to it and take it from there!
Echoes of Change#037.dst: 好，那，我知道 {p} 的衛兵哨站在哪。我們直接過去，到了再說！
Echoes of Change#037.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#038.src: Ha, settle down a little. I think we need to be a bit more prepared than that. But, yes, time is of the essence, so let us head there first. I will attempt to think of a plan on the way.
Echoes of Change#038.dst: 哈，冷靜一點。我認為我們需要準備得比這更周全。不過，是的，時間緊迫，所以我們先過去。路上我會試著想出一個計畫。
Echoes of Change#038.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#039.src: Whatever, man! Too much planning often spoils the results... but, sure! Let's meet outside the tallest building in {p}. First tunnel to the right leads there!
Echoes of Change#039.dst: 隨你啦，老兄！計畫太多常常反而壞事……不過，好吧！我們約在 {p} 最高的那棟樓外面。右邊第一條隧道就通到那裡！
Echoes of Change#039.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#040.src: Meet up with Yuman and Mora in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#040.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的 {p} 與 Yuman 和 Mora 會合。

Echoes of Change#042.src: Good grief, this town's a mess. How does anyone live here?
Echoes of Change#042.dst: 老天，這座城真是一團亂。這裡到底怎麼住人的？
Echoes of Change#042.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#043.src: Eh, ya get used to it. Here, follow me.
Echoes of Change#043.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#044.src: See, {p} utilizes all the space it has... stacking things atop each other. For example, this so-called "skyscraper" is mainly an apartment building!
Echoes of Change#044.dst: 你看，{p} 把每一寸空間都用上了……東西一層疊一層。舉例來說，這棟所謂的「摩天樓」主要是棟公寓！
Echoes of Change#044.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#045.src: Then... what exactly are we doing here?
Echoes of Change#045.dst: 那……我們到底來這裡做什麼？
Echoes of Change#045.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#046.src: I said mainly, man. The top floors serve as the offices for the local commander and constables. That's also why we've got to climb this staircase!
Echoes of Change#046.dst: 我說的是「主要」，老兄。頂樓那幾層是本地指揮官和警備隊的辦公室。這也就是為什麼我們得爬這道樓梯！
Echoes of Change#046.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#047.src: Hope you guys are in shape!
Echoes of Change#047.dst: 希望你們兩個體力還行！
Echoes of Change#047.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#049.src: Uh... we're on a mission, right? Trying to prove ourselves? Schedules are up there, so...
Echoes of Change#049.dst: 呃……我們在執行任務吧？要證明自己？排班表在上面，所以……
Echoes of Change#049.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#050.src: We cannot just... walk in there and grab the schedules! You do realize that, right? {u} and I are wanted by the crown! Even showing ourselves here at all is a risk.
Echoes of Change#050.dst: 我們不能就這樣……大搖大擺走進去把排班表拿走！你明白吧？{u} 和我都是被王室通緝的人！光是在這裡露臉就已經是風險了。
Echoes of Change#050.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#051.src: Hey man, these soldiers see hundreds of people every day! If you don't give 'em a reason to pay attention, your faces won't stick out at all.
Echoes of Change#051.dst: 嘿老兄，這些士兵每天要看幾百個人！只要你不給他們理由去注意，你的臉根本不會被記住。
Echoes of Change#051.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#052.src: Yuman, we were going to make a plan before rushing in. Did you forget about that?
Echoes of Change#052.dst: Yuman，我們說好要先擬個計畫再衝進去。你忘了嗎？
Echoes of Change#052.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#053.src: Riiight. Right. Sorry, I got excited. I am right though - it wouldn't be hard for me to just talk us through this!
Echoes of Change#053.dst: 對——喔。對。抱歉，我太興奮了。不過我說的沒錯——我要靠一張嘴帶我們混過去並不難！
Echoes of Change#053.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#054.src: Sigh... here, I have a better plan. Let us take some guard uniforms and put them on, and reach the schedules that way. We'll stand out even less, then.
Echoes of Change#054.dst: 唉……來，我有個更好的計畫。我們去弄幾件衛兵制服穿上，用那種方式去拿排班表。這樣我們會更不起眼。
Echoes of Change#054.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#055.src: Ohh. A sneak mission! That's good. They should definitely have some spare uniforms in the tower... *and*, it should be pretty empty this time of day. Everyone's out patrolling.
Echoes of Change#055.dst: 喔——潛入任務！這個好。塔裡應該一定有備用制服，「而且」這個時段那裡應該相當空。大家都出去巡邏了。
Echoes of Change#055.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#056.src: So, good plan, man! I like it! Let's get to it!
Echoes of Change#056.dst: 所以，好計畫，老兄！我喜歡！我們動手吧！
Echoes of Change#056.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#057.src: Find guard uniforms inside of the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#058.src: See? I told you, nobody's here!
Echoes of Change#058.dst: 看吧？我就說了，一個人都沒有！
Echoes of Change#058.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#059.src: Ha. I suppose I should have faith in your knowledge. My apologies.
Echoes of Change#059.dst: 哈。看來我該對你的了解多點信心。抱歉。
Echoes of Change#059.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#060.src: ...ah, is that really all? I thought they would be harder to find.
Echoes of Change#060.dst: ……啊，就這樣而已？我還以為會更難找。
Echoes of Change#060.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#061.src: With how many guards have to come through here every day for uniform exchanges, this is just the easiest way. More efficient having it out here.
Echoes of Change#061.dst: 考慮到每天有多少衛兵要來這裡換制服，這樣最省事。放在外面比較有效率。
Echoes of Change#061.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#064.src: Oh, you are just going for it... I see. {u}, let's wait outside until he's done.
Echoes of Change#064.dst: 喔，你就這樣直接換了……我懂了。{u}，我們到外面等他換完吧。
Echoes of Change#064.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#065.src: Well? Thoughts? How do I look?
Echoes of Change#065.dst: 怎樣？有什麼想法？我看起來如何？
Echoes of Change#065.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#066.src: Like an average Roughworks soldier, I suppose.
Echoes of Change#066.dst: 大概就像個普通的 Roughworks 士兵吧。
Echoes of Change#066.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#067.dst: 不知道 Zeph 會怎麼想……
Echoes of Change#067.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#069.src: Ah- haha, uh, n- nothin! Your turn!
Echoes of Change#069.dst: 啊——哈哈，呃，沒、沒什麼！換你了！
Echoes of Change#069.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#070.src: This uniform is so... uncomfortable. And to think, I nearly signed up for this...
Echoes of Change#070.dst: 這件制服真是……不舒服。想想我當年還差點就簽下去了……
Echoes of Change#070.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#071.src: Yeah, you'd think they'd complain about it more! But nah, they're all... stoic.
Echoes of Change#071.dst: 對啊，你會以為他們應該多抱怨幾句才對！結果沒有，他們全都……一副木然的樣子。
Echoes of Change#071.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#072.src: Yes... well, {u}, it's your turn. Hurry, please. Someone could come up here at any time.
Echoes of Change#072.dst: 是啊……好了，{u}，換你了。請快一點。隨時可能有人上來。
Echoes of Change#072.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#073.src: Find guard schedules inside the guard tower at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#073.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的衛兵塔裡找到衛兵排班表。

Echoes of Change#074.src: Very well. Let us get this over with.
Echoes of Change#074.dst: 很好。我們把這件事辦完吧。
Echoes of Change#074.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#075.src: From what I heard from Yulie, the commander usually keeps the schedules in the top office. Let's get looking!
Echoes of Change#075.dst: 我聽 Yulie 說，指揮官通常把排班表放在最上層的辦公室。我們開始找吧！
Echoes of Change#075.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#076.src: So, you? A soldier? What's the story there?
Echoes of Change#076.dst: 所以，你？當兵？那是怎麼回事？
Echoes of Change#076.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#077.src: Sigh... the story is it was a choice between joining the military, and following in my parents' footsteps. And I did not especially want to do the latter.
Echoes of Change#077.dst: 唉……說穿了就是，我得在從軍和繼承父母的路之間選一個。而我實在不太想選後者。
Echoes of Change#077.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#079.src: They worked as woodcutters. A relatively common job in the {p}, but... I simply wanted to distance myself from them.
Echoes of Change#079.dst: 他們是伐木工。在 {p} 算是相當常見的工作，但……我就是想跟他們拉開距離。
Echoes of Change#079.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#080.src: The military seemed my best option... until I met Syndra, that is. Still... I regret I could not do more for Sui. She did not take my departure well.
Echoes of Change#080.dst: 軍隊看起來是我最好的選擇……直到我遇見 Syndra。不過……我還是後悔沒能為 Sui 多做點什麼。我離開的時候，她並不好受。
Echoes of Change#080.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#081.src: Hey, you were doing what was best for you, right? And it looks like you and Sui are all good now, so it turned out alright in the end.
Echoes of Change#081.dst: 嘿，你當時是在做對你自己最好的選擇，對吧？而且看起來你跟 Sui 現在也和好了，所以最後結果還不錯嘛。
Echoes of Change#081.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#083.src: Woah there! Eheh, sorry folks, didn't see-
Echoes of Change#083.dst: 哇喔！欸嘿，抱歉各位，我沒看到——
Echoes of Change#083.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#084.src: Wait. You three - if you have your equipment, you should be out on the streets. State your business here.
Echoes of Change#084.dst: 等等。你們三個——如果裝備都拿了，你們應該在街上才對。說明你們在這裡做什麼。
Echoes of Change#084.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#085.src: ... Well? I'm not hearing an answer. State. Your. Business.
Echoes of Change#085.dst: ……怎麼？我沒聽到回答。說。明。你們的來意。
Echoes of Change#085.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#086.src: I- ah. We... we were looking for...
Echoes of Change#086.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#088.dst: 我這位同伴請多包涵，兄弟！
Echoes of Change#088.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#089.src: Ya know how the stress gets. Festival's coming up, lots to worry about! Not getting much sleep - all that.
Echoes of Change#089.dst: 你知道壓力是怎麼回事的嘛。慶典就要到了，一堆事要煩！睡也睡不夠——就那樣。
Echoes of Change#089.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#090.src: Heck, I don't even remember what I last ate, hahaha!
Echoes of Change#090.dst: 媽的，我連自己上一餐吃了什麼都不記得了，哈哈哈！
Echoes of Change#090.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#091.src: Ha! Yeah, I've been feeling that. Commander's got us working overtime, it's a whole mess.
Echoes of Change#091.dst: 哈！對啊，我也有這種感覺。指揮官叫我們加班，整個亂成一團。
Echoes of Change#091.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#092.src: Oh, hey, why don't y'all join us for some drinks after the shift?
Echoes of Change#092.dst: 喔，欸，你們下班後要不要跟我們去喝一杯？
Echoes of Change#092.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#093.src: Sounds great, man! Guess we'll meet you boys then! You got the night shift too, right?
Echoes of Change#093.dst: 聽起來不錯啊，老兄！那到時候見囉！你們也是上夜班對吧？
Echoes of Change#093.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#094.src: Yeah. Drew the short straw, unfortunately. The commander has us doing them the next few days...
Echoes of Change#094.dst: 對。可惜抽到了短籤。指揮官接下來幾天都排我們夜班……
Echoes of Change#094.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#095.src: At this rate, we'll be too damn tired to enjoy the festival! Like... give us a break, right?
Echoes of Change#095.dst: 照這樣下去，我們會累到根本沒力氣享受慶典！拜託……給我們喘口氣好嗎？
Echoes of Change#095.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#096.src: Yeah, yeah. Same sorta thing here! I got paired up with these newbies, and the commander's got us on festival shift.
Echoes of Change#096.dst: 對啊對啊。這邊也差不多！我被配了這幾個新人，指揮官又把我們排到慶典班。
Echoes of Change#096.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#097.src: Ouch. That's rough. Good luck out there.
Echoes of Change#097.dst: 唉喲。那真慘。外頭保重啊。
Echoes of Change#097.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#098.src: Ey, thanks! But yeah, I'm still showin' them the ropes, and all that. We only got the news, like, an hour ago, so we're going to check the schedules.
Echoes of Change#098.dst: 欸，謝啦！不過對啊，我還在帶他們熟悉狀況之類的。我們大概一小時前才收到通知，所以正要去看排班表。
Echoes of Change#098.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#099.src: Ah, management... putting newbies on festival shift? I wonder what the commander's thinking? Well, good luck with that.
Echoes of Change#099.dst: 啊，管理階層……把新人排到慶典班？指揮官到底在想什麼？嗯，那你們加油了。
Echoes of Change#099.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#101.src: ...told ya I could talk us through it.
Echoes of Change#101.dst: ……就跟你說我一張嘴能帶我們混過去吧。
Echoes of Change#101.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#102.src: That was... impressive. I did not think it could be done.
Echoes of Change#102.dst: 那真是……令人佩服。我沒想到辦得到。
Echoes of Change#102.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#103.src: Ah, y'know... they're still people at the end of the day.
Echoes of Change#103.dst: 啊，你知道的……他們說到底也還是人。
Echoes of Change#103.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#104.src: I... suppose. I apologize, I do not know why I... froze up there. I should know what I'm doing...
Echoes of Change#104.dst: 我……大概吧。抱歉，我不知道自己剛才為什麼……僵住了。我明明應該知道該怎麼做的……
Echoes of Change#104.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#105.src: Hey, it happens. For the record, I'm sorry for bein' a bit rough with ya. Had to convince them somehow.
Echoes of Change#105.dst: 嘿，這種事難免。順帶一提，剛剛對你有點不客氣，抱歉。總得想辦法讓他們信。
Echoes of Change#105.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#106.src: No worries, Yuman, I understand. Now, ah... let us find the schedules before someone else notices we are not supposed to be here.
Echoes of Change#106.dst: 沒事的，Yuman，我理解。現在，啊……在別人也發現我們不該在這裡之前，我們去找排班表吧。
Echoes of Change#106.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#108.src: The schedules were further up, yes?
Echoes of Change#108.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#110.src: Start writing them down, would you?
Echoes of Change#110.dst: 開始把它們抄下來，可以嗎？
Echoes of Change#110.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#111.src: It's more guards than we typically see in Auburn festivals, that's for certain... I hope Syndra anticipated this.
Echoes of Change#111.dst: 這比我們在 Auburn 慶典上看到的衛兵多得多，這是確定的……希望 Syndra 有預料到這一點。
Echoes of Change#111.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#112.src: She seems like the kind of lady to have back-up plans for her back-up plans... I wouldn't worry too much.
Echoes of Change#112.dst: 她看起來是那種會替備案再準備備案的人……我不會太擔心。
Echoes of Change#112.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#113.src: I suppose you're right. Now, we should make our way out of here before anyone else arrives.
Echoes of Change#113.dst: 我想你說得對。現在，我們該在其他人來之前離開這裡。
Echoes of Change#113.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#114.src: Return to The Steel Feather using the tunnel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and find Yusanu and Sui.
Echoes of Change#114.dst: 從 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 的隧道返回鋼羽，並找到 Yusanu 和 Sui。

Echoes of Change#115.src: I could really use a nap after that.
Echoes of Change#115.dst: 弄完這一趟，我真的很需要睡一下。
Echoes of Change#115.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#116.src: Seems like our mission is done. Let's head back.
Echoes of Change#116.dst: 看來我們的任務完成了。我們回去吧。
Echoes of Change#116.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#117.src: ...and we'll need to keep things calm back here while we're gone.
Echoes of Change#117.dst: ……而我們不在的時候，這裡得保持平靜。
Echoes of Change#117.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#118.src: Of course, of course. Wouldn't want anyone to panic.
Echoes of Change#118.dst: 當然，當然。不會想讓任何人恐慌的。
Echoes of Change#118.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#119.src: I'm less concerned about panic, and more about stress. I know Quill will stay behind during the festival itself, but it'll be good to have additional help.
Echoes of Change#119.dst: 比起恐慌，我更擔心的是壓力。我知道慶典期間 Quill 會留守，但多一份幫手總是好的。
Echoes of Change#119.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#120.src: Yes, ma'am. I can handle it.
Echoes of Change#120.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#122.src: Ah, I should get going. I'll see if I can track down Quill.
Echoes of Change#122.dst: 啊，我該走了。我去看看能不能找到 Quill。
Echoes of Change#122.speaker: Jiro

Echoes of Change#125.src: Oh, Jiro was asking if there was anything he could do to help. I told him he could help Quill keep the peace down here while we're... performing the plan.
Echoes of Change#125.dst: 喔，Jiro 剛才在問有沒有什麼他能幫忙的。我跟他說，我們……執行計畫的時候，他可以幫 Quill 維持下面的秩序。
Echoes of Change#125.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#126.src: He's... been acting a little out of character, truth be told... though it might just be the stress of the upcoming festival causing it.
Echoes of Change#126.dst: 說實話，他……最近有點反常……不過也可能只是慶典將至的壓力造成的。
Echoes of Change#126.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#127.src: But either way - how are things going?
Echoes of Change#127.dst: 不管怎樣——事情進行得如何？
Echoes of Change#127.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#128.src: That's good to hear. I know I placed a lot of responsibility on your shoulders...
Echoes of Change#128.dst: 那就好。我知道我把很重的擔子壓在你肩上了……
Echoes of Change#128.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#129.src: In truth, you have the most experience out of all the youngsters. And to ensure this plan succeeds... it's good to have you keep an eye on things.
Echoes of Change#129.dst: 老實說，這些年輕人裡就屬你經驗最豐富。而為了確保這個計畫成功……有你盯著事情，我比較放心。
Echoes of Change#129.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#130.src: Mmn. I apologize for placing so much on your shoulders.
Echoes of Change#130.dst: 嗯。抱歉把這麼多事壓在你肩上。
Echoes of Change#130.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#131.src: But you have the most experience out of all the youngsters, and we need to ensure this plan works... we have no choice.
Echoes of Change#131.dst: 但這些年輕人裡就屬你經驗最豐富，而我們必須確保這個計畫成功……我們別無選擇。
Echoes of Change#131.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#132.src: But, regardless - Mora gave me the guard positions you retrieved. I was working with Rex and Zeph on our next steps, based off that information.
Echoes of Change#132.dst: 不過，總之——Mora 把你們取得的衛兵配置交給我了。我剛才在跟 Rex 和 Zeph 根據那些情報討論下一步。
Echoes of Change#132.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#133.src: They've gone off... somewhere, I don't know where. Until they return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#133.dst: 他們去……某個地方了，我不知道在哪。在他們回來之前，你去看看 Sui 和 Yusanu 需不需要什麼。
Echoes of Change#133.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#134.src: Until Rex and Zeph return, you should go see if Sui and Yusanu need anything.
Echoes of Change#134.dst: 在 Rex 和 Zeph 回來之前，你去看看 Sui 和 Yusanu 需不需要什麼。
Echoes of Change#134.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#135.src: Oh! {u}, you're back! How did it, um, go?
Echoes of Change#135.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#136.src: Oh! Good! It, um, went smoothly, I hope? Mora and Yuman got along?
Echoes of Change#136.dst: 喔！太好了！嗯，順利吧，我希望？Mora 和 Yuman 處得還好嗎？
Echoes of Change#136.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#137.src: If they got the schedules, it was probably fine. So, {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#137.dst: 既然他們拿到排班表了，那應該就沒問題。所以，{u}，你也是來幫我們的嗎？
Echoes of Change#137.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#138.src: Hehe, I guess that's what happens when you show off all those skills of yours!
Echoes of Change#138.dst: 嘿嘿，我想這就是把你那身本事秀出來的下場吧！
Echoes of Change#138.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#139.src: Yep! Oh, speaking of... {u}, are you here to help us out too?
Echoes of Change#139.dst: 沒錯！喔，說到這個……{u}，你也是來幫我們的嗎？
Echoes of Change#139.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#140.src: We've been putting together those explosives Syndra requested. I think we've decided on an easily produced model.
Echoes of Change#140.dst: 我們一直在做 Syndra 要的那些炸藥。我想我們已經定下一個容易量產的型號了。
Echoes of Change#140.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#141.src: By, um, "we," he mostly means him. I can, ha, barely understand what he's going on about.
Echoes of Change#141.dst: 他說的「我們」，嗯，主要是指他。我，哈，幾乎聽不懂他在講什麼。
Echoes of Change#141.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#142.src: Hey, don't sell yourself short! You've been helpful! I would've never thought to utilize water in the design if it weren't for your suggestion.
Echoes of Change#142.dst: 喂，別這樣看輕自己！你幫了很多忙！要不是你提議，我根本不會想到在設計裡用水。
Echoes of Change#142.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#143.src: Oh... thank you. {u}, we were playing around the idea of hiding magical water inside the, um, explosive... but I, ah, don't know how to hold its power when I can't... see it.
Echoes of Change#143.dst: 喔……謝謝你。{u}，我們在試一個想法，把魔法水藏在，嗯，炸藥裡面……可是我，呃，不知道在看不見它的時候要怎麼掌握住它的力量。
Echoes of Change#143.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#144.src: Magic or not, using water in the design will make the explosion look more dangerous and powerful than it actually is! It's genius!
Echoes of Change#144.dst: 不管有沒有魔法，在設計裡用水會讓爆炸看起來比實際上更危險、更有威力！這根本是天才！
Echoes of Change#144.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#145.src: Now, we just need to put it together...
Echoes of Change#145.dst: 現在，我們只要把它組起來就好……
Echoes of Change#145.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#146.src: Eheh. Maybe? I need to run some tests while it's being assembled, and Sui needs to stand guard in case it's about to actually explode.
Echoes of Change#146.dst: 欸嘿。也許吧？組裝的時候我得跑一些測試，而 Sui 得在旁邊警戒，以防它真的要爆炸。
Echoes of Change#146.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#147.src: If things go awry, I'll, um, surround it in a ball of water.
Echoes of Change#147.dst: 如果出了差錯，我會，嗯，用一團水把它包起來。
Echoes of Change#147.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#148.src: Yep! Okay, no more questions, we've got to get to it! Click the explosive parts whenever you're ready.
Echoes of Change#148.dst: 沒錯！好了，別再問了，我們得動工了！準備好就點擊那些炸彈零件。
Echoes of Change#148.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#149.src: Help assemble the explosives inside the workshop at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#150.src: (Coal Block): Can only be placed on the outer tiles.
Echoes of Change#150.dst: (煤炭磚)：只能放在外圈的格子上。
Echoes of Change#150.speaker: Casing

Echoes of Change#151.src: (Dark Gray Concrete Powder): Can only be placed on the inner tiles.
Echoes of Change#151.dst: (深灰色混凝土粉末)：只能放在內圈的格子上。
Echoes of Change#151.speaker: Gunpowder

Echoes of Change#152.src: (White Wool Block): Must touch the orange chemical.
Echoes of Change#152.dst: (白色羊毛)：必須碰到橘色的藥劑。
Echoes of Change#152.speaker: Fuse

Echoes of Change#154.src: (Bone): Can remove any block from the board.
Echoes of Change#154.dst: (骨頭)：可以移除盤面上的任何方塊。
Echoes of Change#154.speaker: Wrench

Echoes of Change#155.src: Collect all pieces by finishing {~} puzzles!
Echoes of Change#155.dst: 完成 {~} 道謎題來收集所有零件！
Echoes of Change#155.speaker: Bomb Piece

Echoes of Change#157.src: I think Sui and I will perform a few more tests... maybe a test run or two... but the construction went okay, so I should be able to produce some more.
Echoes of Change#157.dst: 我想 Sui 和我會再跑幾次測試……也許試爆個一兩次……不過組裝過程還算順利，所以我應該做得出更多。
Echoes of Change#157.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#158.src: And, eheh, hopefully not blow up my workshop...
Echoes of Change#158.dst: 而且，欸嘿，希望別把我的工坊炸掉……
Echoes of Change#158.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#159.src: Oh, no... {u}, are you sure you, um, can't stick around, a bit longer? Just, in case?
Echoes of Change#159.dst: 喔，不……{u}，你確定不能，嗯，多留一會兒嗎？就，以防萬一？
Echoes of Change#159.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#160.src: Nope, there's still stuff to do! On that subject - {u}, Rex was looking for you earlier.
Echoes of Change#160.dst: 不行，還有事要做呢！說到這個——{u}，Rex 剛才在找你。
Echoes of Change#160.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#161.src: Meet up with Zeph and Rex for the next assignment at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#161.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Zeph 和 Rex 會合，接下下一個任務。

Echoes of Change#162.src: {u}, finally! There you are! I was getting restless.
Echoes of Change#162.dst: {u}，你總算來了！我都等到坐不住了。
Echoes of Change#162.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#163.src: I w- was quite comfortable... actually.
Echoes of Change#163.dst: 我、我剛剛還蠻舒服的……其實。
Echoes of Change#163.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#164.src: Oh, are the nerves getting to you Zeph?
Echoes of Change#164.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#165.src: I- I know... But it f- fe- feels like everyone else is doing okay, while I- I'm not even doing an- any- anything, and I'm a- al- already panicking.
Echoes of Change#165.dst: 我、我知道……可是感覺別人都好好的，而我、我什、什麼都還沒做，就已經在慌了。
Echoes of Change#165.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#166.src: Hey, everyone else is also feeling nervous, Zeph. Some of us are just... better at hiding it than others.
Echoes of Change#166.dst: 嘿，大家也都很緊張，Zeph。只是有些人比較……會藏而已。
Echoes of Change#166.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#167.src: Re- really? For some reason, that m- ma- makes me feel a lot better... uh, n- no offense!
Echoes of Change#167.dst: 真、真的嗎？不知道為什麼，這、這讓我好受多了……呃，沒、沒有冒犯的意思！
Echoes of Change#167.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#168.src: We're all nervous, Zeph. It's a risky plan. But we know what we're doing. We have to trust we'll succeed.
Echoes of Change#168.dst: 我們都很緊張，Zeph。這是個有風險的計畫。但我們知道自己在做什麼。我們得相信我們會成功。
Echoes of Change#168.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#169.src: Ha ha, v- ver- very funny, {u}. I- I- I'm trying. I am! It's just... hard not to be an- anxious.
Echoes of Change#169.dst: 哈哈，很、很好笑喔，{u}。我、我、我在努力了。真的！只是……很難不焦、焦慮。
Echoes of Change#169.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#170.src: You're fine, Zeph. I'd be surprised if you weren't anxious, honestly. Given what we're planning on doing...
Echoes of Change#170.dst: 你沒事的，Zeph。老實說，你要是不焦慮我才會意外。考慮到我們打算做的事……
Echoes of Change#170.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#171.src: I g- guess... It's all just st- st- starting to sink in.
Echoes of Change#171.dst: 我、我想也是……這一切才剛開、開始有真實感。
Echoes of Change#171.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#172.src: Look, the more you think about it, the worse it'll get. Accept the feeling for what it is, then put it aside for now.
Echoes of Change#172.dst: 聽著，你愈想它就會愈糟。接受這種感覺，然後暫時把它放到一邊。
Echoes of Change#172.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#173.src: We've got work to do, and... we really can't afford to screw it up.
Echoes of Change#173.dst: 我們有事要做，而且……我們真的不能搞砸。
Echoes of Change#173.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#175.src: That's all I ask. Anyway, {u}, Zeph and I looked over the schedules with Syndra earlier. We've marked a couple of spots we want to check out.
Echoes of Change#175.dst: 我要的就這樣。總之，{u}，Zeph 和我稍早跟 Syndra 一起看過排班表了。我們標出了幾個想去看看的地點。
Echoes of Change#175.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#176.src: So- s- so let's go see them in person! Uh, Rex, I c- ca- can carry the arrows and electric ch- charges for you.
Echoes of Change#176.dst: 那、那我們就去實地看看吧！呃，Rex，我可、可以幫你背箭和電能彈。
Echoes of Change#176.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#178.src: ...and those are the faces I usually see around, so-
Echoes of Change#178.dst: ……以上就是我平常會看到的那些面孔，所以——
Echoes of Change#178.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#179.src: Ah- Rex, Zeph, and {u}! Rather auspicious timing.
Echoes of Change#179.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#180.src: Oh. hey! Have you seen the guard schedules yet?
Echoes of Change#180.dst: 喔，嘿！你們看過衛兵排班表了嗎？
Echoes of Change#180.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#181.src: We have, yep. Quill and I were just talking about some of the escape routes I had in mind.
Echoes of Change#181.dst: 看過了。Quill 和我剛才正在討論我想到的幾條撤離路線。
Echoes of Change#181.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#182.src: Are you heading out for your assignment then?
Echoes of Change#182.dst: 那你們是要出發去執行任務了？
Echoes of Change#182.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#183.src: We were j- just about to head to {p} for ours, too. P- per- perhaps we could go there together?
Echoes of Change#183.dst: 我、我們也正要去 {p} 執行我們的。也、也許我們可以一起過去？
Echoes of Change#183.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#184.src: Hmm... yes, I suppose we could- though, I'll want {u}'s opinion on our ideas as well. Once you finish with Rex and Zeph, would you care to join us?
Echoes of Change#184.dst: 唔……好，我想可以——不過，我也想聽聽 {u} 對我們構想的意見。等你跟 Rex 和 Zeph 忙完，願意來加入我們嗎？
Echoes of Change#184.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#185.src: Then let's get going. No time to waste.
Echoes of Change#185.dst: 那我們出發吧。別浪費時間了。
Echoes of Change#185.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#186.src: Find Zeph and Rex in {p} at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#187.src: Rex, please don't pick the highest rooftops.
Echoes of Change#187.dst: Rex，拜託別挑最高的那些屋頂。
Echoes of Change#187.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#188.src: You better not pick out the highest roof tops. I'm not sure I can get up that far.
Echoes of Change#188.dst: 你最好別挑最高的那些屋頂。我不確定我爬不爬得上去。
Echoes of Change#188.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#189.src: I'm just not sure I'd be able to climb up to them.
Echoes of Change#189.dst: 我只是不確定自己爬不爬得上去。
Echoes of Change#189.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#190.src: Well, Yuman seems to do it just fine! But okay, I'll pick out something more accessible for you.
Echoes of Change#190.dst: 欸，Yuman 看起來爬得很順啊！不過好啦，我會挑比較好上去的地方給你。
Echoes of Change#190.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#192.src: Hm... {u}, I don't suppose you would happen to have seen Jiro?
Echoes of Change#192.dst: 唔……{u}，你該不會剛好看到 Jiro 吧？
Echoes of Change#192.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#193.src: Syndra told me he had gone looking for me, but I haven't seen him all day!
Echoes of Change#193.dst: Syndra 說他來找我，可是我一整天都沒看到他！
Echoes of Change#193.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#194.src: Well, I suppose I can always find him after we're done here. No need to delay this any longer.
Echoes of Change#194.dst: 算了，這裡忙完之後我隨時都能找到他。沒必要再耽擱下去了。
Echoes of Change#194.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#195.src: Just one more day... a- a- and then it'll be done. I can m- make it that far.
Echoes of Change#195.dst: 再撐一天……然、然後就結束了。我撐、撐得到那時候。
Echoes of Change#195.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#196.src: T- took you a bit, huh?
Echoes of Change#196.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#197.src: Great! You're here! Slowpoke. I thought Zeph's races in the {p} would've prepared you for this!
Echoes of Change#197.dst: 太好了！你來了！慢吞吞的。我還以為 Zeph 在 {p} 跟你賽跑早就把你練起來了呢！
Echoes of Change#197.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#198.src: Quill and Yulie? They've started on their assignment already. Quill said to tell you to just join up with them once you're done here.
Echoes of Change#198.dst: Quill 和 Yulie？他們已經開始執行任務了。Quill 說要跟你講，這裡忙完就去跟他們會合。
Echoes of Change#198.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#199.src: Ha! Or m- ma- maybe you're too slow!
Echoes of Change#199.dst: 哈！也、也可能是你太慢了！
Echoes of Change#199.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#200.src: We should get started, before we draw any attention towards ourselves... I've got the map here. Zeph and I have marked out two locations.
Echoes of Change#200.dst: 我們該開始了，免得引起注意……地圖在我這裡。Zeph 和我標了兩個地點。
Echoes of Change#200.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#201.src: We're ch- checking both, since we wanted to sp- split Rex and Yulie on two different v- vantage points.
Echoes of Change#201.dst: 兩、兩個都要看，因為我們想把 Rex 和 Yulie 分在兩個不、不同的制高點。
Echoes of Change#201.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#202.src: I'll p- point them out for you. Ready?
Echoes of Change#202.dst: 我來指、指給你看。準備好了嗎？
Echoes of Change#202.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#204.src: Always a second with you... fine, just let us know when you are ready.
Echoes of Change#204.dst: 跟你講話總要多等一秒……好啦，你準備好就跟我們說。
Echoes of Change#204.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#206.src: And there's the s- sec- second one!
Echoes of Change#206.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#207.src: Okay. Let's g- get to work!
Echoes of Change#207.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#208.src: Here, Zeph, hand me those arrows. Keep the charges though, I think your point would be better for Yulie.
Echoes of Change#208.dst: 來，Zeph，那些箭給我。電能彈你留著，我覺得你那個點比較適合 Yulie。
Echoes of Change#208.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#209.src: Sure... w- wait, why do we need {u} for this?
Echoes of Change#209.dst: 好……等、等等，我們為什麼需要 {u} 做這個？
Echoes of Change#209.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#210.src: To check our work, I guess? They can help assess the vantage points. Maybe they'll spot some potential issues we missed.
Echoes of Change#210.dst: 來驗收我們的成果吧，我想？他們可以幫忙評估這些制高點。說不定能看出我們漏掉的問題。
Echoes of Change#210.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#212.src: Just make your way up however you can!
Echoes of Change#212.dst: 你想辦法自己爬上去就好！
Echoes of Change#212.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#213.src: Get to the top of the two buildings at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#214.src: Yeah, hey. Not much fer conversation today, 'm afraid.
Echoes of Change#214.dst: 嗯，你好。今天沒什麼心情聊天，抱歉啊。
Echoes of Change#214.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#215.src: This job's gonna be the death a' me eventually. If it's not slippin off the ledge, 's gonna be breakin' my damn back.
Echoes of Change#215.dst: 這份工作遲早會要了我的命。不是從邊上滑下去，就是把我這條老腰給操斷。
Echoes of Change#215.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#216.src: Beggars can't be choosers though, huh? Literally, in my case...
Echoes of Change#216.dst: 不過討飯的沒得挑，對吧？我這情況還真是字面上的意思……
Echoes of Change#216.speaker: Timasca Mason

Echoes of Change#218.src: Ha! Well, o- of course I am! I can't let y- you start beating me... I ha- have an image to maintain!
Echoes of Change#218.dst: 哈！我當、當然是啊！我不能讓你開始贏我……我、我還有形象要顧呢！
Echoes of Change#218.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#219.src: B- but you didn't! Maybe next time... wh- what are we at now? Zeph {~}... {u} {~}?
Echoes of Change#219.dst: 但、但你沒有！下次吧……我、我們現在是幾比幾？Zeph {~1}……{u} {~2}？
Echoes of Change#219.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#220.src: Ha... so, th- this is the spot.
Echoes of Change#220.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#221.src: This should c- co- cover Rex's blind spots well enough...
Echoes of Change#221.dst: 這裡應該能補、補足 Rex 的死角……
Echoes of Change#221.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#222.src: What do you th- think? Does it look okay?
Echoes of Change#222.dst: 你覺、覺得呢？看起來還行嗎？
Echoes of Change#222.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#223.src: Perfect! So are we g- good then?
Echoes of Change#223.dst: 太好了！那我們就沒、沒問題了？
Echoes of Change#223.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#224.src: Well... I- I guess it is a little high up for Y- Yulie... but I think it's fine.
Echoes of Change#224.dst: 呃……我、我想對 Y、Yulie 來說是有點高……不過我覺得還好。
Echoes of Change#224.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#225.src: Let me p- put down the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#225.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#226.src: Hey... if you h- hurry, you can make it to the other spot be- before Rex does!
Echoes of Change#226.dst: 嘿……你如、如果快一點，可以趕在 Rex 之前到另一個點！
Echoes of Change#226.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#227.src: She's n-never been the most agile...
Echoes of Change#227.dst: 她從來就不、不是最靈活的那個……
Echoes of Change#227.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#228.src: Uh, d- don't tell her I said that!!!
Echoes of Change#228.dst: 呃，別、別跟她說我這麼講！！！
Echoes of Change#228.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#230.src: I saw you beat R- Rex earlier! Not like that's hard, th- though!
Echoes of Change#230.dst: 我剛才看到你贏了 R、Rex！雖、雖然那也不難啦！
Echoes of Change#230.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#231.src: But since we're done here... it's t- time for you to assist Quill and Yulie, Superhero.
Echoes of Change#231.dst: 不過既然這裡完成了……該、該去協助 Quill 和 Yulie 了，超級英雄。
Echoes of Change#231.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#232.src: ...heh. I- I should go get some more pr- practice in, though... before tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#232.dst: ……呵。不過我、我該再去練一下……在明天之前。
Echoes of Change#232.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#233.src: Quill and Yulie are out- outside Sovereign Soosu's mansion, by the way.
Echoes of Change#233.dst: 對了，Quill 和 Yulie 在 Soosu 統領的宅邸外、外面。
Echoes of Change#233.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#234.src: I'll be there in a second!
Echoes of Change#234.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#235.src: Phew... well, seems like you got here before me.
Echoes of Change#235.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#236.src: Oh. Thanks. But you've seen me do better!
Echoes of Change#236.dst: 喔。謝了。不過你看過我表現更好的時候！
Echoes of Change#236.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#238.src: Hm... would you agree this spot overlooks the whole square?
Echoes of Change#238.dst: 唔……你會不會同意，這個位置俯瞰得到整個廣場？
Echoes of Change#238.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#239.src: From what I've heard, the festival always takes place right here. And this looks like it gives us a pretty good coverage of the area...
Echoes of Change#239.dst: 就我聽說的，慶典每年都辦在這裡。而這個位置看起來對整片區域的覆蓋相當不錯……
Echoes of Change#239.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#241.src: Just... okay? You're sure? If you have any concerns, speak up.
Echoes of Change#241.dst: 只是……還行？你確定？有任何疑慮就說出來。
Echoes of Change#241.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#242.src: ...no? You're just gonna go mute? Okay. Sure.
Echoes of Change#242.dst: ……沒有？你就打算裝啞巴？好吧。隨便。
Echoes of Change#242.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#243.src: Really? Well, if you say so.
Echoes of Change#243.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#244.src: I guess that means our work here is done!
Echoes of Change#244.dst: 那我想我們這邊的工作就完成了！
Echoes of Change#244.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#245.src: Just gotta leave the equipment here...
Echoes of Change#245.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#246.src: Alright! That's my part done, but you've still got to assess Zeph's location.
Echoes of Change#246.dst: 好！我這部分完成了，不過你還得去評估 Zeph 那個位置。
Echoes of Change#246.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#247.src: I'll head down and wait for him to be done. I'll see you back at the Steel Feather, I guess.
Echoes of Change#247.dst: 我先下去等他弄完。那我們鋼羽見了。
Echoes of Change#247.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#248.src: Good luck with Quill and Yulie. That's the last bit of preparation we have to do, right?
Echoes of Change#248.dst: 跟 Quill 和 Yulie 那邊加油。那是我們最後要做的準備了吧？
Echoes of Change#248.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#250.src: Alright! That's my part done... and I saw you over with Zeph earlier, too.
Echoes of Change#250.dst: 好！我這部分完成了……而且我剛才也看到你在 Zeph 那邊了。
Echoes of Change#250.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#251.src: So I think that means we're done. I'll go get Zeph and head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#251.dst: 所以我想我們都完成了。我去找 Zeph，然後回鋼羽。
Echoes of Change#251.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#252.src: I need to get some practice in before tomorrow... I know the plan shouldn't involve any fighting, but... in case things go wrong, I need to be sure I can hit my shots when it counts.
Echoes of Change#252.dst: 明天之前我得再練一下……我知道這個計畫不該牽涉到任何戰鬥，可是……萬一出了差錯，我得確定關鍵時刻我射得中。
Echoes of Change#252.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#253.src: I think I saw Quill and Yulie out by Sovereign Soosu's mansion. So, go find them! Don't keep them waiting!
Echoes of Change#253.dst: 我好像看到 Quill 和 Yulie 在 Soosu 統領的宅邸外面。所以，去找他們吧！別讓他們等！
Echoes of Change#253.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#254.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 找到 Yulie 和 Quill。

Echoes of Change#255.src: Ah, {u}! I take it you have finished up with Rex and Zeph?
Echoes of Change#255.dst: 啊，{u}！我想你跟 Rex 和 Zeph 那邊忙完了？
Echoes of Change#255.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#256.src: We've been trying to get an idea of the general feel of the coming festival.
Echoes of Change#256.dst: 我們一直在試著感受一下即將到來的慶典是什麼氛圍。
Echoes of Change#256.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#257.src: As with every year, people usually just see it as a day off of work. That's all it really is for them.
Echoes of Change#257.dst: 跟每年一樣，大家通常只把它當成一天不用上工的日子。對他們來說那就是全部了。
Echoes of Change#257.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#258.src: Rather different from what you had experienced in the {p}, yes? The people there see their festival as a way to celebrate their culture.
Echoes of Change#258.dst: 跟你在 {p} 體驗到的相當不同，是吧？那裡的人把他們的慶典視為慶祝自身文化的方式。
Echoes of Change#258.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#259.src: Hm... that's hard to imagine. Though, in a way, I guess the Roughworks festival also celebrates our culture... just, only the part of it about working hard.
Echoes of Change#259.dst: 唔……那有點難想像。不過某種意義上，我想 Roughworks 的慶典也算是在慶祝我們的文化吧……只是只慶祝「努力工作」那一部分。
Echoes of Change#259.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#260.src: Indeed... indeed. Well, as we are all here, let us begin the task. According to the map, we have three possible escape routes to scout out.
Echoes of Change#260.dst: 確實……確實。好了，既然大家都到齊了，我們開始吧。根據地圖，我們有三條可能的撤離路線要勘查。
Echoes of Change#260.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#261.src: And they're the ones most likely to be optimal, with the information from the guard schedules... alright. Let's head to the first location then.
Echoes of Change#261.dst: 而且從衛兵排班表的情報來看，它們是最可能理想的幾條……好，那我們去第一個地點吧。
Echoes of Change#261.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#262.dst: 跟著 Yulie 和 Quill 前往 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}]。

Echoes of Change#263.src: First on the list... our tunnel.
Echoes of Change#263.dst: 名單上第一個……我們的隧道。
Echoes of Change#263.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#264.src: The reason it's been so safe for us all this time is 'cause the place is always empty.
Echoes of Change#264.dst: 這地方之所以一直這麼安全，就是因為它總是空的。
Echoes of Change#264.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#265.src: It's still a developing area in the city, so people rarely come here.
Echoes of Change#265.dst: 這裡在城裡還算開發中的區域，所以很少有人來。
Echoes of Change#265.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#266.src: And according to our guard schedules... it should remain unguarded during the festival, as well.
Echoes of Change#266.dst: 而根據我們的衛兵排班表……慶典期間這裡應該也一樣不會有人看守。
Echoes of Change#266.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#267.src: {u}, why don't you have a look around?
Echoes of Change#267.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#268.src: Assess the first escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#273.src: Why are you even here? Don't you have work to do? Tomorrow is a VERY special day.
Echoes of Change#273.dst: 你到底為什麼在這裡？你沒工作要做嗎？明天可是「非常」特別的日子。
Echoes of Change#273.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#275.src: Well LUCKY you!!!!!! But SOME of us have work to do!!!!! What do you want?!
Echoes of Change#275.dst: 那「你」可真好命！！！！！！可是「有些人」還有工作要做！！！！！你到底想幹嘛？！
Echoes of Change#275.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#276.src: Thoughts? You interrupted my work to ask about my THOUGHTS?
Echoes of Change#276.dst: 想法？你打斷我的工作，就為了問我的「想法」？
Echoes of Change#276.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#277.src: I mean... if you really want to know. It's great! A day of NO work. You know what that means!
Echoes of Change#277.dst: 我是說……如果你真的想知道的話。好得很啊！一整天「不用工作」。你知道那代表什麼吧！
Echoes of Change#277.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#278.src: I get to dust off my Roughworks Vodka and not worry for {~} hours! Great days ahead, I tell ya!
Echoes of Change#278.dst: 我可以把我的 Roughworks 伏特加拿出來撢一撢，然後 {~} 個小時什麼都不用煩！好日子在前頭啊，我跟你說！
Echoes of Change#278.speaker: Construction Worker

Echoes of Change#279.src: Have a look around, {u}. Perhaps you'll find something which compromises this option.
Echoes of Change#279.dst: 四處看看吧，{u}。也許你會發現什麼會讓這個選項失效的東西。
Echoes of Change#279.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#281.src: Hm... seems fine, all things considered. Let's get to the next option. It's on the other side of the city.
Echoes of Change#281.dst: 唔……綜合來看，似乎沒問題。我們去下一個選項吧。它在城的另一頭。
Echoes of Change#281.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#282.src: Head to the second escape point at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#283.src: Hm... the map tells me it should be around here somewhere, but... Yulie?
Echoes of Change#283.dst: 唔……地圖說它應該就在這附近，可是……Yulie？
Echoes of Change#283.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#284.src: Right, this one. The plan was to escape using the underground river.
Echoes of Change#284.dst: 對，就是這個。計畫是利用地下河撤離。
Echoes of Change#284.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#285.src: This path should lead us to it, I think.
Echoes of Change#285.dst: 我想這條路應該會通到那裡。
Echoes of Change#285.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#287.src: It... might require us to, ah, dive through a small underwater section.
Echoes of Change#287.dst: 這……可能需要我們，呃，潛過一小段水下路徑。
Echoes of Change#287.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#289.src: Look, it's perfectly safe! Mostly. I've tried it before, it works!
Echoes of Change#289.dst: 欸，那絕對安全！大致上啦。我試過，行得通！
Echoes of Change#289.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#290.src: Oh, dear. Do I want to know why?
Echoes of Change#290.dst: 我的天。我需要知道你為什麼試過嗎？
Echoes of Change#290.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#291.src: Work stuff... an investigation led me to it. A thief had used it to escape the city- it's not important.
Echoes of Change#291.dst: 工作上的事……一件調查把我帶到那裡的。有個小偷靠它逃出城——那不重要。
Echoes of Change#291.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#292.src: I see. Let's mark this one as our lowest priority. Only to be used in case of emergencies.
Echoes of Change#292.dst: 我明白了。這條就標成最低優先。只在緊急狀況下使用。
Echoes of Change#292.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#293.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#293.dst: 不過無論如何，還是值得四處看看。{u}，也許你會發現什麼。
Echoes of Change#293.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#294.src: Assess the second escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#295.src: Bless you, child. I hope her Majesty brings you health.
Echoes of Change#295.dst: 願你蒙福，孩子。願陛下賜你健康。
Echoes of Change#295.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#296.src: Her Majesty sure is powerful. And tomorrow... it's her big day.
Echoes of Change#296.dst: 陛下真是強大。而明天……是她的大日子。
Echoes of Change#296.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#297.src: And I get to see her! Bless us all.
Echoes of Change#297.dst: 而我能親眼見到她！願我們都蒙福。
Echoes of Change#297.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#298.dst: 是什麼風把你吹來的，孩子。
Echoes of Change#298.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#300.src: Do you like how I have decorated my palace. And my most priced posetion... my own personal symbol of her Majesty of Fruma!
Echoes of Change#300.dst: 你喜歡我把宮殿佈置成這樣嗎。還有我最珍貴的收藏……我私人的 Fruma 女王陛下之象徵！
Echoes of Change#300.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#301.src: She is great, don't you agree. And all that she has done for us, her children.
Echoes of Change#301.dst: 她很偉大，你不同意嗎。還有她為我們這些子民所做的一切。
Echoes of Change#301.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#302.src: Unfortunately I am a bad subject, a very very bad subject! I couldn't work due to my illness... And... I lost my original home - the much worse version.
Echoes of Change#302.dst: 很遺憾我是個不好的子民，非常非常不好的子民！我因為生病沒辦法工作……然後……我失去了我原本的家——那個差得多的版本。
Echoes of Change#302.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#303.src: This home is much more homely.
Echoes of Change#303.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#305.src: That was my own fault for being lazy and worthless. But now! Now I've devoted myself to her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#305.dst: 那是我自己懶惰又沒用的錯。但現在！現在我把自己奉獻給了陛下。
Echoes of Change#305.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#306.src: She is the reason I'm alive and well! She even cured my mental illness. I feel much better now.
Echoes of Change#306.dst: 她是我還活著、還健康的原因！她甚至治好了我的心病。我現在感覺好多了。
Echoes of Change#306.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#307.src: It's absolutely splendid! A whole day of getting to celebrate her majesty... Nothing could beat that.
Echoes of Change#307.dst: 那簡直好極了！一整天都能慶祝陛下……沒有什麼比得上這個。
Echoes of Change#307.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#308.src: Every festival brings me closer to her. I even feel like I will soon join her in the capital!
Echoes of Change#308.dst: 每一次慶典都讓我更接近她。我甚至覺得我很快就能到首都去與她同在！
Echoes of Change#308.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#309.src: Join her as her right hand by the throne!
Echoes of Change#309.dst: 作為她王座旁的左右手與她同在！
Echoes of Change#309.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#312.src: Hah... Since when did you tu - turn - turn into two people!
Echoes of Change#312.dst: 哈……你什麼時候變、變、變成兩個人的！
Echoes of Change#312.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#313.src: Well yeees... Of course it is! *hic*
Echoes of Change#313.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#314.src: Do - d- do you like it? Smells quite freshhhh.
Echoes of Change#314.dst: 你——你、你喜歡嗎？聞起來很新鮮吧。
Echoes of Change#314.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#315.src: Oh I feel like I ne- need to... hurl... *burp*
Echoes of Change#315.dst: 喔我覺得我好像要……吐了……*嗝*
Echoes of Change#315.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#317.src: Oh! That one... Ya know, I don't even know what year it is anymore.
Echoes of Change#317.dst: 喔！那個啊……你知道嗎，我連現在是哪一年都不知道了。
Echoes of Change#317.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#318.src: None of of it matters anymore. This is my life n-now!
Echoes of Change#318.dst: 那些都不重要了。這就是我現在的生活了！
Echoes of Change#318.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#319.src: But it would be worth taking a look around, either way. {u}, maybe you'll find something.
Echoes of Change#319.dst: 不過無論如何，還是值得四處看看。{u}，也許你會發現什麼。
Echoes of Change#319.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#320.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#320.dst: 哇……你的雙胞胎是什麼時候出現的？
Echoes of Change#320.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#321.src: Wow... When did your twin appear?
Echoes of Change#321.dst: 哇……你的雙胞胎是什麼時候出現的？
Echoes of Change#321.speaker: Citizen

Echoes of Change#322.src: Alright... to the final spot, then. The gate to the {p}.
Echoes of Change#322.dst: 好了……那就去最後一個地點吧。通往 {p} 的門。
Echoes of Change#322.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#323.src: Head to the third escape route at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#324.src: Sigh... our last stop. That wall, always looming over me...
Echoes of Change#324.dst: 唉……我們最後一站。那道牆，總是壓在我頭上……
Echoes of Change#324.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#326.src: Yes, yes. I'm alright. {u}... is something on your mind?
Echoes of Change#326.dst: 沒事，沒事。我沒事。{u}……你有什麼心事嗎？
Echoes of Change#326.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#327.src: Ah... yes. I understand your meaning.
Echoes of Change#327.dst: 啊……是的。我明白你的意思。
Echoes of Change#327.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#328.src: But... we do not have the space to house all of these people. No matter how much I wish we could.
Echoes of Change#328.dst: 但是……我們沒有空間收容所有這些人。無論我多希望我們能。
Echoes of Change#328.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#329.src: Some of these people also refuse to accept our help. They're too deeply rooted in the Roughworks' work culture.
Echoes of Change#329.dst: 而且這些人裡也有一些拒絕我們的幫助。他們在 Roughworks 的工作文化裡扎得太深了。
Echoes of Change#329.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#330.src: I was one of them, once. My brothers and I, we used to live around there. After... well, we didn't have anywhere else to go.
Echoes of Change#330.dst: 我以前也是其中之一。我和我的兄弟們，我們以前就住在那附近。在……嗯，我們無處可去。
Echoes of Change#330.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#331.src: When Quill offered to take us off the street, I... almost declined the offer. I didn't need his pity, I thought. I was supporting our family just fine.
Echoes of Change#331.dst: Quill 提議把我們帶離街頭的時候，我……差點就拒絕了。我當時想，我不需要他的同情。我把家撐得好好的。
Echoes of Change#331.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#332.src: ...but I remembered our parents. How our mother worked three jobs just to keep our house. How even those jobs weren't enough, and eventually... she fell ill.
Echoes of Change#332.dst: ……可是我想起了我們的父母。想起我母親如何身兼三份工，只為了保住我們的房子。想起連那三份工都不夠，最後……她病倒了。
Echoes of Change#332.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#334.src: I realized... that was where I was heading. Working myself to death, and- and for what? Then they'd be left on their own anyway.
Echoes of Change#334.dst: 我意識到……那就是我正在走的路。把自己累死，然後——然後為了什麼？他們最後還是會孤零零一個人。
Echoes of Change#334.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#335.src: For what it is worth, I am deeply glad you chose to come with me, Yulie.
Echoes of Change#335.dst: 無論如何，Yulie，我都深深慶幸你選擇跟我走。
Echoes of Change#335.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#336.src: ...yeah. It's hard accepting help when you're in that position, is all. It's easier to turn to substances to keep working, to survive...
Echoes of Change#336.dst: ……嗯。只是說，人在那種處境下，接受幫助是很難的。轉而依賴那些藥物來繼續工作、繼續活下去，反而比較容易……
Echoes of Change#336.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#337.src: But that's what we're doing all this for, isn't it? To build a better Fruma.
Echoes of Change#337.dst: 但我們做這一切不就是為了這個嗎？為了建立一個更好的 Fruma。
Echoes of Change#337.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#338.src: ...hm. I believe someone is about to pass through the gate.
Echoes of Change#338.dst: ……唔。我想有人要從那道門過來了。
Echoes of Change#338.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#339.src: What? More guards for the festival? Or-
Echoes of Change#339.dst: 什麼？慶典的增援衛兵嗎？還是——
Echoes of Change#339.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#340.src: I'm not certain, Yulie. But we should avoid being spotted.
Echoes of Change#340.dst: 我不確定，Yulie。但我們該避免被看見。
Echoes of Change#340.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#342.src: You're the newest addition to our set, then. Good punctuality- You've made a good first impression.
Echoes of Change#342.dst: 那麼你就是我們這一組最新加入的了。守時是好事——你的第一印象不錯。
Echoes of Change#342.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#343.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I was... told I would be meeting Sovereign Soosu here?
Echoes of Change#343.dst: Zhiraok 統領。我……我聽說我會在這裡見到 Soosu 統領？
Echoes of Change#343.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#344.src: Attention to formalities is good too, but no need to stand on ceremony right now, alright? Soosu, we'll meet in a short while.
Echoes of Change#344.dst: 注重禮節也很好，不過現在不必拘泥形式，好嗎？Soosu 我們過一會兒就會見到。
Echoes of Change#344.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#345.src: But as for you- Tasim, correct? This'll be your first time visiting {p}? It's the province's central hub for technological development. Needs work, but what do you think?
Echoes of Change#345.dst: 至於你——是 Tasim，對吧？這是你第一次來 {p}？這裡是全行省技術發展的中樞。還有待改進，不過你覺得如何？
Echoes of Change#345.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#346.src: It is, yes...ah, to both your questions. I don't think I've ever seen anything this... densely packed! It definitely leaves an impression.
Echoes of Change#346.dst: 是的……啊，兩個問題的答案都是。我想我從沒見過這麼……密集的地方！確實令人印象深刻。
Echoes of Change#346.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#347.src: I, ah... appreciate the help getting adjusted to all this. I'm still getting used to... holding this authority, I guess. I'm not sure I'm comfortable having the soldiers defer to me yet.
Echoes of Change#347.dst: 我，啊……很感謝你幫我適應這一切。我還在習慣……握有這種權限吧。我還不太自在，讓士兵們對我唯命是從。
Echoes of Change#347.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#348.src: I was in the same position as you once too. {~} years seems long, especially to me, but compared to the rest? I'm barely on the board. You'll get used to it, so don't worry.
Echoes of Change#348.dst: 我以前也跟你處在同樣的位置。{~} 年聽起來很長，尤其對我而言，但跟其他人比起來呢？我還只是剛上場而已。你會習慣的，別擔心。
Echoes of Change#348.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#349.src: On that tangent... How's your recovery been? I remember how taxing ascension was for me... But you look like you're taking to it naturally.
Echoes of Change#349.dst: 說到這個……你恢復得如何？我還記得飛升對我來說有多耗損……不過你看起來適應得挺自然的。
Echoes of Change#349.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#350.src: I'm getting there. The blessing's a little strange, but it's not unlike what I was already able to do. I just need to practice using it.
Echoes of Change#350.dst: 我在慢慢好起來。那份祝福有點奇怪，不過跟我本來就做得到的事並非全然不同。我只是需要多練習使用它。
Echoes of Change#350.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#351.src: Golden! I know how tough being the newest can be, so don't be afraid to ask me if you need help solving for your own problems.
Echoes of Change#351.dst: 太好了！我知道當最新的那個有多難熬，所以如果你需要幫忙解自己的題，別怕來問我。
Echoes of Change#351.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#352.src: Speaking of... How's that project you were scouted for? Her Majesty and the Spymaster haven't shown their work to the rest of the class yet.
Echoes of Change#352.dst: 說到這個……你被延攬去做的那個計畫進行得如何？陛下和諜報總管還沒把他們的成果拿給我們其他人看呢。
Echoes of Change#352.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#353.src: I've been filled in on the details already, but Her Majesty wants me to fully recover before we start.
Echoes of Change#353.dst: 細節我已經聽過了，不過陛下要我完全恢復之後才開始。
Echoes of Change#353.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#354.src: I can tell you more later. You said you'd be able to bring me to Sovereign Soosu?
Echoes of Change#354.dst: 我晚點可以多告訴你一些。你說你能帶我去見 Soosu 統領？
Echoes of Change#354.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#355.src: I'll put a pin in that, then. I think she'll be reaching the end of her sequence on whatever she was working on by now... Follow me, her mansion's this way.
Echoes of Change#355.dst: 那這件事先擱著。我想她手上那個東西的序列這時候應該快跑完了……跟我來，她的宅邸在這邊。
Echoes of Change#355.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#356.src: Talk to Yulie and Quill at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#356.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Yulie 和 Quill 談話。

Echoes of Change#358.src: Indeed... we already had two Sovereigns to concern ourselves with. And now, a third.
Echoes of Change#358.dst: 確實……我們本來就已經有兩位統領要應付。現在又多了第三位。
Echoes of Change#358.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#359.src: He's not one of the Sovereigns I know about... is he new?
Echoes of Change#359.dst: 他不是我知道的那幾位統領……他是新的嗎？
Echoes of Change#359.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#360.src: Perhaps... but this could be a problem. We know nothing about this new Sovereign...
Echoes of Change#360.dst: 也許吧……但這可能是個問題。我們對這位新統領一無所知……
Echoes of Change#360.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#361.dst: 你——什麼？！哪裡來的？Auburn 嗎？
Echoes of Change#361.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#362.src: Hm... no, Syndra would have mentioned him if he were from the {p}.
Echoes of Change#362.dst: 唔……不，如果他是 {p} 來的，Syndra 會提過他。
Echoes of Change#362.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#363.src: You have Sovereign friends...? Why? How?
Echoes of Change#363.dst: 你有統領朋友……？為什麼？怎麼會？
Echoes of Change#363.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#364.src: There could be any number of explanations... but it does not matter.
Echoes of Change#364.dst: 解釋可能有很多種……但那不重要。
Echoes of Change#364.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#365.src: If you know him, we need information. What can you tell us?
Echoes of Change#365.dst: 如果你認識他，我們需要情報。你能告訴我們什麼？
Echoes of Change#365.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#366.src: Really. Because from my perspective, working directly under the Crown doesn't sound like something a good person would do!
Echoes of Change#366.dst: 是嗎。因為在我看來，直接替王室做事聽起來不像好人會做的事！
Echoes of Change#366.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#367.src: That could certainly be a concern... though, we were not expecting to fight any Sovereigns, regardless.
Echoes of Change#367.dst: 那確實可能是個隱憂……不過話說回來，我們本來就沒打算跟任何統領交手。
Echoes of Change#367.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#368.src: Ah... so you knew him before his ascension, then.
Echoes of Change#368.dst: 啊……所以你在他飛升之前就認識他了。
Echoes of Change#368.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#369.src: This could be a good thing for us. If he only recently ascended, he's likely to lack experience with the Queen's blessing.
Echoes of Change#369.dst: 這對我們來說可能是好事。如果他是最近才飛升的，他多半還不熟悉女王的祝福。
Echoes of Change#369.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#370.src: We need to report back to Syndra about this... this changes things.
Echoes of Change#370.dst: 我們得回去向 Syndra 報告這件事……這改變了局面。
Echoes of Change#370.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#371.src: Come on, let's head back to the Steel Feather.
Echoes of Change#371.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#373.src: If it comes down to it... and you are forced to face him. Would you be ready to kill your former friend, if necessary?
Echoes of Change#373.dst: 如果真的走到那一步……而你被迫要面對他。必要的話，你準備好殺死你的舊友嗎？
Echoes of Change#373.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#374.src: ...think on it, for now. If we are lucky, you won't need the answer.
Echoes of Change#374.dst: ……先想一想吧。如果我們運氣好，你不會需要那個答案。
Echoes of Change#374.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#375.src: Return to The Steel Feather and discuss the final steps at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#376.src: Everyone! Gather around, we return with... news. Both good and bad.
Echoes of Change#376.dst: 各位！都過來，我們帶回了……消息。有好也有壞。
Echoes of Change#376.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#377.src: Welcome back. I hesitate to ask, but what are the news?
Echoes of Change#377.dst: 歡迎回來。我不太想問，但消息是什麼？
Echoes of Change#377.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#378.src: We can begin with the good news. We have properly assessed each of our escape routes, and ordered them from most to least preferable..
Echoes of Change#378.dst: 我們可以從好消息開始。我們已經妥善評估了每一條撤離路線，並依優先順序排好了。
Echoes of Change#378.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#379.src: That's good. With that, we should have completed all the necessary preparations for the festival... then what are the bad news?
Echoes of Change#379.dst: 那很好。這樣一來，慶典所需的準備應該都完成了……那壞消息呢？
Echoes of Change#379.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#380.src: We've learned of a third Sovereign who will be present at the festival. A new one, by the name of Tasim.
Echoes of Change#380.dst: 我們得知慶典上會有第三位統領在場。是位新的，名叫 Tasim。
Echoes of Change#380.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#381.src: Oh, great. As if having both Sovereigns Zhiraok and Soosu to deal with wasn't bad enough... and now there's another one?
Echoes of Change#381.dst: 噢，太好了。好像光是要應付 Zhiraok 和 Soosu 兩位統領還不夠糟一樣……現在又多一個？
Echoes of Change#381.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#382.src: This doesn't change anything. We'll proceed as planned.
Echoes of Change#382.dst: 這不改變任何事。我們照計畫進行。
Echoes of Change#382.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#383.src: Er... with all due respect, we'd stand no chance facing three Sovereigns wielding the Queen's blessing. I doubt we could even defeat one!
Echoes of Change#383.dst: 呃……恕我直言，面對三位手握女王祝福的統領，我們毫無勝算。我懷疑我們連一位都打不贏！
Echoes of Change#383.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#384.src: We have all the necessary steps prepared. We know what we need to do. The plan doesn't involve facing the Sovereigns at all - the only target is Her Majesty.
Echoes of Change#384.dst: 所有必要的步驟我們都準備好了。我們知道自己該做什麼。這個計畫根本不涉及與統領交手——唯一的目標是女王陛下。
Echoes of Change#384.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#385.src: Syndra... I agree with the young ones. It's incredibly risky, and the risk factor has only increased. Perhaps we... wait for next year?
Echoes of Change#385.dst: Syndra……我同意年輕人的看法。風險極高，而且風險係數還只增不減。也許我們……等明年？
Echoes of Change#385.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#387.src: Yes, the outlook of this fight is not great. Yes, the odds are against us. As I have said previously, I will be the face of the operation.
Echoes of Change#387.dst: 是的，這一戰的前景不佳。是的，勝算不站在我們這邊。就像我先前說的，我會是這場行動的門面。
Echoes of Change#387.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#388.src: I will deal the final blow, and I alone will draw the wrath of the crown and the people. The rest of you will work from the shadows. No one will even know you're involved.
Echoes of Change#388.dst: 我會親手給出最後一擊，而王室與人民的怒火將由我一人承受。其餘的人在暗處行動。沒有人會知道你們有份。
Echoes of Change#388.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#389.src: Syndra, old friend... are you certain your judgement isn't... clouded? I understand your troubled history, I do... but is it worth burning yourself to ash? What would Eli-
Echoes of Change#389.dst: Syndra，老朋友……你確定你的判斷沒有被……蒙蔽嗎？我理解你那段痛苦的過往，我真的理解……但這值得你把自己燒成灰嗎？Eli 會怎麼——
Echoes of Change#389.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#390.src: Enough, Quill. My judgment is clear. I do not believe an additional Sovereign changes anything. Now, are you still ready to proceed?
Echoes of Change#390.dst: 夠了，Quill。我的判斷很清楚。我不認為多一位統領會改變什麼。現在，你們還準備好要進行嗎？
Echoes of Change#390.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#391.src: ... Well, the explosives are already made and ready... so I guess we might as well use 'em.
Echoes of Change#391.dst: ……嗯，炸藥已經做好、準備就緒了……所以我想我們不妨就用了吧。
Echoes of Change#391.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#393.src: After seeing the state of our citizens today... we've waited long enough. I'm ready to take action.
Echoes of Change#393.dst: 在今天看過我們同胞的處境之後……我們已經等得夠久了。我準備好行動了。
Echoes of Change#393.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#394.src: So long as Zeph joins, I'm in.
Echoes of Change#394.dst: 只要 Zeph 參加，我就參加。
Echoes of Change#394.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#395.src: Wh- what? Why w- wo- would my choice matter to you...? Uh, an- anyway, I already pr- pro- promised to help Syndra, no m- matter what.
Echoes of Change#395.dst: 什、什麼？我的選擇為什麼會影、影響到你……？呃，總、總之，我已經答應要幫 Syndra 了，無、無論如何。
Echoes of Change#395.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#396.src: Sigh. Fine, I'm outvoted. But I don't like this.
Echoes of Change#396.dst: 唉。好吧，我輸了票數。但我不喜歡這樣。
Echoes of Change#396.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#399.src: I am fighting. But I will not allow you to take the fall for it entirely by yourself.
Echoes of Change#399.dst: 我會參戰。但我不會允許你獨自承擔這一切。
Echoes of Change#399.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#400.src: You don't need to protect me, Mora. This is my decision, and-
Echoes of Change#400.dst: 你不需要保護我，Mora。這是我的決定，而且——
Echoes of Change#400.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#401.src: And my decision, Syndra, is to follow you into battle.
Echoes of Change#401.dst: 而我的決定，Syndra，是跟著你上戰場。
Echoes of Change#401.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#404.src: That will be all I ask from most of you. Try to rest and relax before tomorrow's festival. I'll do a final briefing before we head out in the morning.
Echoes of Change#404.dst: 我對大多數人的要求就這樣了。明天慶典之前試著休息、放鬆。早上出發前我會做最後一次簡報。
Echoes of Change#404.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#405.src: {u}, I have one final request to make of you. I'd like to duel you again... this time, I'll give it my all, and I expect the same of you.
Echoes of Change#405.dst: {u}，我對你還有最後一個請求。我想再跟你決鬥一次……這一次我會全力以赴，也期待你一樣。
Echoes of Change#405.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#406.src: Meet me by the north-eastern tracks.
Echoes of Change#406.dst: 到東北邊的鐵軌旁找我。
Echoes of Change#406.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#407.src: My water magic has gotten a lot better. I will help, no matter what!
Echoes of Change#407.dst: 我的水魔法進步很多了。我一定會幫上忙的！
Echoes of Change#407.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#409.src: U-uh, yeah. I was just a-about to go there myself.
Echoes of Change#409.dst: 呃、呃，好啊。我正、正要自己過去呢。
Echoes of Change#409.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#410.src: I- I can't rest now. I n-need to practice.
Echoes of Change#410.dst: 我、我現在沒辦法休息。我得、得去練習。
Echoes of Change#410.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#411.src: All things considered, I am excited to find out how my explosives will perform.
Echoes of Change#411.dst: 撇開一切不談，我還蠻期待看看我的炸藥表現如何的。
Echoes of Change#411.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#413.src: I hope Yus' tech doesn't let me down...
Echoes of Change#413.dst: 希望 Yus 的裝置別讓我失望……
Echoes of Change#413.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#414.src: I have a really bad feeling about tomorrow. Syndra better know what she's doing.
Echoes of Change#414.dst: 我對明天有很不好的預感。Syndra 最好知道自己在做什麼。
Echoes of Change#414.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#415.src: Resistance will always come with a cost. I just hope the cost isn't too great.
Echoes of Change#415.dst: 反抗永遠是有代價的。我只希望代價不要太大。
Echoes of Change#415.speaker: Mora

Echoes of Change#416.src: Meet up with Syndra for your duel at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#416.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與 Syndra 會合進行決鬥。

Echoes of Change#417.src: We don't know what tomorrow will hold. We might succeed without any issues - and I really, truly hope that'll be the case.
Echoes of Change#417.dst: 我們不知道明天會發生什麼。我們可能毫無阻礙地成功——我真心、真的希望是那樣。
Echoes of Change#417.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#418.src: However... We need to be ready for anything. That's why I want to challenge you.
Echoes of Change#418.dst: 但是……我們得為任何狀況做好準備。所以我才想向你挑戰。
Echoes of Change#418.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#419.src: Of everyone here, you and I are the closest to the power level of a Sovereign. If we can each hold our own in this duel... we might stand a chance.
Echoes of Change#419.dst: 在這裡的所有人之中，你和我是最接近統領那個力量層級的。如果我們兩個都能在這場決鬥中站得住腳……我們或許就有機會。
Echoes of Change#419.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#420.src: As I said, I won't be holding back. I expect you to do the same.
Echoes of Change#420.dst: 我說過了，我不會留手。我期待你也一樣。
Echoes of Change#420.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#421.src: ... I haven't told you the most important part of my plan yet, have I?
Echoes of Change#421.dst: ……我還沒把計畫裡最重要的那部分告訴你，對吧？
Echoes of Change#421.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#422.src: I've said that I'll deal the final blow on Her Majesty. In order to do that... I will use my blessing from above, and kill her in one strike.
Echoes of Change#422.dst: 我說過我會親手給女王陛下最後一擊。為了做到那件事……我會動用來自上方的那份祝福，一擊殺死她。
Echoes of Change#422.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#423.src: I'll let everyone else know tomorrow morning... But do you understand why I need this duel? I... I need to be certain I can do it.
Echoes of Change#423.dst: 明天早上我會讓所有人知道……但你明白我為什麼需要這場決鬥了嗎？我……我必須確定我做得到。
Echoes of Change#423.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#424.src: Alright. When you're ready, speak to me again, and we shall proceed.
Echoes of Change#424.dst: 好。你準備好了就再來跟我說話，我們就開始。
Echoes of Change#424.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#427.src: Alright. Let the best soldier win!
Echoes of Change#427.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#429.src: Truthfully, I didn't expect to be able to best you. You've been able to hone your skills and train your magic far more than I ever could have.
Echoes of Change#429.dst: 說實話，我本來就沒指望能勝過你。你磨練技藝、鍛鍊魔法的程度，遠遠超過我這輩子所能做到的。
Echoes of Change#429.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#430.src: So many years... and the solution was right in front of me. But I didn't know to look!
Echoes of Change#430.dst: 這麼多年……解答就在我眼前。可是我不懂得去看！
Echoes of Change#430.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#431.src: ...it doesn't matter now. We've come this far already. We'll have to work with what we have.
Echoes of Change#431.dst: ……現在說這些也沒用了。我們已經走到這一步。我們只能用手上有的東西去做。
Echoes of Change#431.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#432.src: Listen... there is one other reason I asked for this. I have... something of a hard truth I need to share, and I need you to keep it to yourself.
Echoes of Change#432.dst: 聽著……我要求這場決鬥還有另一個理由。我有一個……不太好聽的事實需要說出來，而我需要你保密。
Echoes of Change#432.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#433.src: There is a significant chance I will fail to land the initial strike. If that happens... I will not make it out of that confrontation alive.
Echoes of Change#433.dst: 有相當大的機率，我的第一擊會落空。若真如此……我不會活著離開那場對決。
Echoes of Change#433.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#434.src: A battle with Her Majesty is no fight at all. How could it be? Could any one person make a dent in such an overwhelming strength?
Echoes of Change#434.dst: 與女王陛下的戰鬥根本稱不上戰鬥。怎麼可能？有任何一個人能在那樣壓倒性的力量上留下凹痕嗎？
Echoes of Change#434.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#435.src: ... So I must do this alone. If anyone must take the fall, it *will* be me.
Echoes of Change#435.dst: ……所以我必須獨自去做。如果非得有人承擔，那個人「就會」是我。
Echoes of Change#435.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#436.src: Because there is no other choice! Because if I am forced to bear yet another year without her by my side, then... then... then I think my spark would finally go out.
Echoes of Change#436.dst: 因為別無選擇！因為如果我被迫再過一年沒有她在身邊的日子，那麼……那麼……我想我心裡那點火終究會熄掉。
Echoes of Change#436.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#438.src: I suppose I may as well tell you. An anger without context must seem strange to an outside observer.
Echoes of Change#438.dst: 我想我不妨告訴你。一份沒有來由的憤怒，在旁人看來想必很奇怪。
Echoes of Change#438.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#439.src: I was once in the military, as you know. But I was no mere soldier, no... I'd risen so far as to approach Her Majesty's inner circle. One of her Wings.
Echoes of Change#439.dst: 你知道我曾在軍中服役。但我不是普通的士兵，不……我一路爬升，幾乎進到了女王陛下的核心圈。成為她的羽翼之一。
Echoes of Change#439.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#440.src: You know, that was the year after Sovereign Selium died. The position for Sovereign of the {p} had opened up. If things had gone differently, could I have...?
Echoes of Change#440.dst: 你知道嗎，那是 Selium 統領死去的隔年。{p} 統領的位置空了出來。如果當時事情走向不同，我會不會……？
Echoes of Change#440.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#441.src: Maybe that's why she did it. She was always sending me on difficult assignments, but...
Echoes of Change#441.dst: 也許那就是她那麼做的原因。她一向派我去執行困難的任務，但是……
Echoes of Change#441.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#442.src: This time, I was ordered to deal with several cursed ones in the Roughworks. Capture if possible, but... well, they wouldn't always come quietly.
Echoes of Change#442.dst: 那一次，我接到的命令是處理 Roughworks 的幾名受詛者。能抓就抓，但……嗯，他們不會總是乖乖就範。
Echoes of Change#442.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#443.src: I've done this before, of course. So I wouldn't have thought much of it, except... except, one of the names I received... I recognized it. Of course I recognized it.
Echoes of Change#443.dst: 這種事我以前也做過。所以我本來不會多想，只除了……只除了，我拿到的名單上有一個名字……我認得。我當然認得。
Echoes of Change#443.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#445.src: I refused! Of course I did - I was asked to kill the love of my life!!
Echoes of Change#445.dst: 我拒絕了！我當然拒絕——他們要我去殺我這輩子最愛的人！！
Echoes of Change#445.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#446.src: She wasn't even cursed. And here and now, we understand the truth of that label... but back then, it was a shock! A normal, working citizen...
Echoes of Change#446.dst: 她根本沒有受詛。而此時此地，我們都明白那個標籤的真相了……但在當時，那是個震撼！一個正常的、在工作的市民……
Echoes of Change#446.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#447.src: I was brought back to the citadel. As I stood before Her Majesty, she told me it was a test. A TEST!! A test of my loyalty to the crown.
Echoes of Change#447.dst: 我被押回城堡。我站在女王陛下面前，她告訴我那是一場測試。一場「測試」！！測試我對王室的忠誠。
Echoes of Change#447.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#448.src: Disgraced, I had my rank and status removed. I was disposed of, sent to {p}, forbidden from ever leaving.
Echoes of Change#448.dst: 我蒙受恥辱，被剝奪了軍階與地位。我被丟棄，送到 {p}，永遠不准離開。
Echoes of Change#448.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#449.src: Of course he knew! Offered condolences and helped get me back up once he became Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#449.dst: 他當然知道！還表達了哀悼，並在他成為統領之後幫我重新站起來。
Echoes of Change#449.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#450.src: He gave me an assignment. To infiltrate the local resistance groups, and keep an eye on them. If I did that... I could restore my honour.
Echoes of Change#450.dst: 他給了我一個任務。潛入當地的反抗組織，盯著他們。只要我做到……我就能恢復名譽。
Echoes of Change#450.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#451.src: Ironically, it's thanks to him that we're here right now. But I can't ever forgive him for standing by and letting the crown keep me trapped there.
Echoes of Change#451.dst: 諷刺的是，我們今天能在這裡，正是多虧了他。但我永遠無法原諒他袖手旁觀，任由王室把我困在那裡。
Echoes of Change#451.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#452.src: ... But he isn't important. Not really. It's who he serves.
Echoes of Change#452.dst: ……但他不重要。真的不重要。重要的是他效忠的那一位。
Echoes of Change#452.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#453.src: Her Majesty... I need her to die. I need to do it myself. Only then, can I finally be at peace...
Echoes of Change#453.dst: 女王陛下……我需要她死。我需要親手做到。唯有如此，我才能終於得到安寧……
Echoes of Change#453.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#454.src: {u}. If I don't survive... I need you to do something for me.
Echoes of Change#454.dst: {u}。如果我沒能活下來……我需要你替我做一件事。
Echoes of Change#454.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#455.src: Keep my children safe. They're all I have left.
Echoes of Change#455.dst: 保護好我的孩子們。他們是我僅剩的一切了。
Echoes of Change#455.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#456.src: ... Try and get some rest. We have a massive challenge ahead of us tomorrow.
Echoes of Change#456.dst: ……去休息一下吧。明天我們面對的是一場巨大的挑戰。
Echoes of Change#456.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#458.src: I did... When we first got into contact with Quill, I asked him to find her.
