Echoes of Change#458.dst: 我有……我們最初跟 Quill 接上線的時候，我請他去找她。
Echoes of Change#458.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#459.src: And... he did. But... she didn't recognize him. She didn't... remember me.
Echoes of Change#459.dst: 然後……他找到了。可是……她不認得他。她不……記得我了。
Echoes of Change#459.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#460.src: Ha... knowing she was still alive past that wall, but that I could never see here again, and that she didn't even... remember me...?
Echoes of Change#460.dst: 哈……知道她還活在那道牆的另一邊，卻知道我再也見不到她，而且她甚至不……記得我了……？
Echoes of Change#460.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#462.src: I tried sending her letters, with Quill's help. I don't know if any of them ever reached her.
Echoes of Change#462.dst: 我試過在 Quill 的幫助下寄信給她。我不知道有沒有任何一封真的送到過。
Echoes of Change#462.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#464.src: It doesn't matter now. It's been... {~} years. Nearly half of my whole life. So long as she's safe... that's all that matters.
Echoes of Change#464.dst: 現在說這些也沒意義了。已經……{~} 年了。將近我一生的一半。只要她平安……那就夠了。
Echoes of Change#464.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#465.src: And if we succeed tomorrow... then...
Echoes of Change#465.dst: 而如果我們明天成功了……那麼……
Echoes of Change#465.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#466.src: Then... maybe we can finally be at peace. Together.
Echoes of Change#466.dst: 那麼……也許我們終於能得到安寧。在一起。
Echoes of Change#466.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#467.src: It was... during a larger assignment. I'd risen through the ranks of the military at a rapid pace, becoming a Wing only three years after joining.
Echoes of Change#467.dst: 那是……在一次更大的任務期間。我在軍中晉升得極快，入伍才三年就成了羽翼。
Echoes of Change#467.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#468.src: In {~} IA, Her Majesty was looking into more long-term solutions for managing the {p}. She requested a team of Wings most suited to the task, and I was selected for it.
Echoes of Change#468.dst: IA {~} 年，女王陛下在尋找管理 {p} 的長期方案。她要求組一支最適任的羽翼小隊，而我被選中了。
Echoes of Change#468.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#469.src: We worked to establish a more centralized management structure... I ended up taking charge, and was later promoted to Captain.
Echoes of Change#469.dst: 我們著手建立更集中的管理架構……我最後接下了指揮，之後被擢升為隊長。
Echoes of Change#469.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#470.src: But one of my first ideas was to go undercover and work at the factories, for a time. I believed I would be able to get a better insight into the situation that way.
Echoes of Change#470.dst: 但我最早的構想之一，是去工廠臥底工作一段時間。我相信那樣能讓我對狀況有更深入的了解。
Echoes of Change#470.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#472.src: I wasn't supposed to get attached. It was just a job, and I'd be visiting many factories...
Echoes of Change#472.dst: 我本來不該動感情的。那只是一份工作，而且我還要走訪許多工廠……
Echoes of Change#472.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#473.src: But I did. And it was the best mistake of my life.
Echoes of Change#473.dst: 但我還是動了。而那是我這輩子犯過最好的錯。
Echoes of Change#473.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#474.src: Even after I moved on, and throughout the whole three years of that assignment, I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#474.dst: 即使在我調離之後，那整整三年的任務期間，我都持續去見她。
Echoes of Change#474.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#475.src: ...even after the assignment ended, and I was recalled to the Citadel... even after I was inducted into the Gendarme... I continued meeting up with her.
Echoes of Change#475.dst: ……即使在任務結束、我被召回城堡之後……即使在我被編入憲兵之後……我仍然持續去見她。
Echoes of Change#475.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#476.src: I... never told her what I really was. I thought it would be safe, for both of us... ha. And how did that turn out...?
Echoes of Change#476.dst: 我……從沒告訴過她我真正的身分。我以為那樣對我們兩個都安全……哈。結果呢……？
Echoes of Change#476.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#480.src: Syndra's about to give her final speech before the festival. Come on, let's get going.
Echoes of Change#480.dst: Syndra 就要在慶典前做最後的講話了。快，我們走。
Echoes of Change#480.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#481.src: Listen to Syndra's last speech before the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].
Echoes of Change#481.dst: 在 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 聆聽 Syndra 慶典前的最後講話。

Echoes of Change#483.src: Today is the day we set our plan into motion. In a few hours, the festival will begin... and that's when we'll strike!
Echoes of Change#483.dst: 今天就是我們把計畫付諸行動的日子。再過幾個小時，慶典就會開始……那就是我們動手的時刻！
Echoes of Change#483.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#484.src: I'll now be handing out assignments. They're different from yesterday's pairings, as they're focused on what we need *during* the festival.
Echoes of Change#484.dst: 我現在分派任務。跟昨天的配對不同，因為這些是針對慶典「進行中」所需要的。
Echoes of Change#484.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#485.src: Zeph and Yuman, you're in charge of placing and detonating the explosives. Yusanu will show you where they are.
Echoes of Change#485.dst: Zeph 和 Yuman，你們負責放置與引爆炸藥。Yusanu 會告訴你們它們在哪裡。
Echoes of Change#485.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#486.src: Rex and Yulie, you're aerial support. Take your positions on the buildings we scouted out yesterday. Provide support for everyone else as needed.
Echoes of Change#486.dst: Rex 和 Yulie，你們是空中支援。到我們昨天勘查好的建築上就位。視需要為其他人提供支援。
Echoes of Change#486.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#487.src: Sui, Yusanu, and {u}. I want you three to stay put on a roof nearby. Once the Queen is dead, chaos is going to break out.
Echoes of Change#487.dst: Sui、Yusanu，還有 {u}。我要你們三個待在附近的一處屋頂上。女王一死，就會爆發混亂。
Echoes of Change#487.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#488.src: I need you three to help calm down the people, and to help fight off any soldiers that oppose us.
Echoes of Change#488.dst: 我需要你們三個幫忙安撫群眾，並協助擊退任何對我們動手的士兵。
Echoes of Change#488.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#489.src: Quill will remain here with the rest of the Steel Feather, and will prepare for the aftermath.
Echoes of Change#489.dst: Quill 會和鋼羽其餘的人留在這裡，為後續做準備。
Echoes of Change#489.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#490.src: I'm no good in a fight, I fear. I'd only slow you down on the battlefield.
Echoes of Change#490.dst: 恐怕我不擅長打鬥。我在戰場上只會拖累你們。
Echoes of Change#490.speaker: Quill

Echoes of Change#491.src: Mora will be lurking in the crowd, and will help me if necessary.
Echoes of Change#491.dst: Mora 會潛伏在人群中，必要時協助我。
Echoes of Change#491.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#492.src: Finally... I'll be stationed on a building above Her Majesty. When the time is right, I will strike her down!
Echoes of Change#492.dst: 最後……我會就位在女王陛下上方的一棟建築。時機一到，我就把她擊殺！
Echoes of Change#492.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#493.src: I hope you're all ready to make history. This won't be easy... but I believe we can pull through.
Echoes of Change#493.dst: 希望你們都準備好創造歷史了。這不會輕鬆……但我相信我們挺得過去。
Echoes of Change#493.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#494.src: I cannot ensure everyone's safety. It is likely civilians will be injured, and some of us may be hurt as well... or... worse.
Echoes of Change#494.dst: 我無法保證每個人的安全。很可能會有平民受傷，而我們之中也可能有人受傷……或者……更糟。
Echoes of Change#494.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#496.src: Resistance and revolution comes at a cost. We need to accept that. I... pray it will not come to that, though.
Echoes of Change#496.dst: 反抗與革命是有代價的。我們必須接受這一點。我……但願不要走到那一步。
Echoes of Change#496.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#497.src: Some of you are scared, nervous. You're right to be. This is dangerous, and risky... but know that I am so, so proud of each and every one of you here today.
Echoes of Change#497.dst: 你們有些人在害怕、在緊張。那是應該的。這件事危險而冒險……但要知道，我為今天在場的每一個人感到無比、無比驕傲。
Echoes of Change#497.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#498.src: We will change Fruma for the better! We will tear down the crown's tyrannical rule, and we will free the people!!
Echoes of Change#498.dst: 我們會讓 Fruma 變得更好！我們會推翻王室的暴政，我們會讓人民自由！！
Echoes of Change#498.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#499.src: Alright! Let us get to work! Find your teams, and meet up at your designated positions at the festival.
Echoes of Change#499.dst: 好了！我們開工吧！找到你們的隊友，到慶典上各自指定的位置會合。
Echoes of Change#499.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#501.src: Meet up with your group at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}] and discuss before heading to the festival.
Echoes of Change#501.dst: 到 [-{~1}, {~2}, -{~3}] 與你的小組會合，在前往慶典前先討論。

Echoes of Change#503.src: Yeah. Got an extra battery as well.
Echoes of Change#503.dst: 帶了。還多帶了一顆電池。
Echoes of Change#503.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#504.src: Perfect. I left charges for you at each spot so when we get to {p} we can pick our positions.
Echoes of Change#504.dst: 很好。我在每個點都替你留了電能彈，所以我們到 {p} 就能各自挑位置。
Echoes of Change#504.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#508.src: Rex, I've never seen a better shot. You won't miss.
Echoes of Change#508.dst: Rex，我沒見過比你更好的射手。你不會偏的。
Echoes of Change#508.speaker: Yulie

Echoes of Change#509.src: Thank you, Yulie. I wish you the best of luck out there.
Echoes of Change#509.dst: 謝謝你，Yulie。祝你在外面一切順利。
Echoes of Change#509.speaker: Rex

Echoes of Change#512.src: Syndra m- marked out some good spots for us, huh?
Echoes of Change#512.dst: Syndra 給我們標的位、位置還不錯吧？
Echoes of Change#512.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#513.src: She did. I'll make sure we stay out of danger! I know my way around those alleyways.
Echoes of Change#513.dst: 確實。我會確保我們不陷入危險！那些巷子我熟。
Echoes of Change#513.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#514.src: Thank you... But I d- don't need a babysitter! I'll be f- fine.
Echoes of Change#514.dst: 謝謝……不過我不、不需要保姆！我不、不會有事的。
Echoes of Change#514.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#515.src: I know you can handle yourself. But seriously, Zeph. I'm not playing around.
Echoes of Change#515.dst: 我知道你能照顧自己。但我是認真的，Zeph。我不是在鬧著玩。
Echoes of Change#515.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#516.src: I need you to be safe. We can't afford to get caught here.
Echoes of Change#516.dst: 我需要你平安。我們不能在這裡被抓到。
Echoes of Change#516.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#517.src: I've never s- seen you this serious before...
Echoes of Change#517.dst: 我從沒見、見過你這麼認真……
Echoes of Change#517.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#518.src: I'm just nervous. I've never done anything like this before.
Echoes of Change#518.dst: 我只是緊張。我從來沒做過這種事。
Echoes of Change#518.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#519.src: Good thing I h- have then, p- pr- princess.
Echoes of Change#519.dst: 那還好我做、做過，公、公主。
Echoes of Change#519.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#520.src: Hi... are you two, um, ready?
Echoes of Change#520.dst: 嗨……你們兩個，嗯，準備好了嗎？
Echoes of Change#520.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#521.src: I... ha, I'm not sure! It's... a lot, isn't it?
Echoes of Change#521.dst: 我……哈，我不確定！這……份量很重，對吧？
Echoes of Change#521.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#522.src: I've been worrying about this new Sovereign... Tasim. {u}, I know you... know him.
Echoes of Change#522.dst: 我一直在擔心那位新的統領……Tasim。{u}，我知道你……認識他。
Echoes of Change#522.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#523.src: It's... it's like Rex said the other day. The Sovereigns aren't our friends. If he joined the crown, then... I'm not sure we can trust him to do the right thing.
Echoes of Change#523.dst: 這……就像 Rex 前幾天說的。統領不是我們的朋友。如果他加入了王室，那……我不確定我們能信任他會做對的事。
Echoes of Change#523.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#524.src: We can't just... sit around worrying about what could happen. We need to, um, stay focused.
Echoes of Change#524.dst: 我們不能只是……坐在這裡擔心可能發生的事。我們得，嗯，保持專注。
Echoes of Change#524.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#525.src: Syndra trusts us! We need to have faith in her plan.
Echoes of Change#525.dst: Syndra 信任我們！我們得對她的計畫有信心。
Echoes of Change#525.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#526.src: Yeah... you're right. Let's take our positions then.
Echoes of Change#526.dst: 嗯……你說得對。那我們就位吧。
Echoes of Change#526.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#527.src: The map says we're supposed to be stationed on top of a building...
Echoes of Change#527.dst: 地圖說我們應該駐守在一棟建築的頂上……
Echoes of Change#527.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#528.src: Head to your designated spot at the festival at [-{~}, {~}, -{~}].

Echoes of Change#529.src: So... this is our spot, then?
Echoes of Change#529.dst: 所以……這裡就是我們的位置了？
Echoes of Change#529.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#530.src: I think so, if I read the map correctly...
Echoes of Change#530.dst: 我想是吧，如果我地圖沒看錯的話……
Echoes of Change#530.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#531.src: ... It feels weird. Just, um, standing by. Like... like we're not really, um, doing anything to, to help.
Echoes of Change#531.dst: ……感覺很奇怪。就這樣，嗯，待在旁邊。好像……好像我們並沒有真的，嗯，做什麼來幫忙。
Echoes of Change#531.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#532.src: A bit... yeah. But like Syndra said, we'll be needed to help in the aftermath. Even if we're not really doing anything until then...
Echoes of Change#532.dst: 是有一點……對。不過就像 Syndra 說的，後續會需要我們幫忙。就算在那之前我們什麼都沒做……
Echoes of Change#532.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#534.src: What's wrong? Something caught your eye?
Echoes of Change#534.dst: 怎麼了？有什麼吸引你注意的嗎？
Echoes of Change#534.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#535.src: Oh, uh... just- it is the festival day, right? The city looks exactly the same as it did when we, um, arrived. No festivities? No stalls, no attractions?
Echoes of Change#535.dst: 喔，呃……只是——今天是慶典日吧？這座城看起來跟我們，嗯，剛到的時候一模一樣。沒有慶祝活動？沒有攤位、沒有表演？
Echoes of Change#535.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#536.src: Oh! Hahaha, you people have attractions in Auburn?
Echoes of Change#536.dst: 喔！哈哈哈，你們 Auburn 有表演的啊？
Echoes of Change#536.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#537.src: Um... yeah! Isn't that... the point of the festival?
Echoes of Change#537.dst: 嗯……有啊！那不就是，嗯，慶典的重點嗎？
Echoes of Change#537.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#538.src: Maybe for you. Here... well, nobody has the time for any of that. The point, for most residents, is having a day off from work.
Echoes of Change#538.dst: 對你們來說也許是。在這裡……嗯，沒有人有時間搞那些。對大多數居民來說，重點是有一天不用上工。
Echoes of Change#538.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#539.src: Oh! That's... nice, I guess. A little sad, though, that that's why, ha, people get excited about it...?
Echoes of Change#539.dst: 喔！那……也不錯吧，我想。不過有點難過，哈，大家興奮的理由居然是這個……？
Echoes of Change#539.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#540.src: Yeah, a bit. That's the Roughworks for you, though.
Echoes of Change#540.dst: 對，是有點。不過 Roughworks 就是這樣。
Echoes of Change#540.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#544.src: Working for the crown is complicated? Helping them oppress to people of Fruma is complicated?!
Echoes of Change#544.dst: 替王室做事很複雜？幫他們壓迫 Fruma 的人民很複雜？！
Echoes of Change#544.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#545.src: Yes! I'd explain it to you, but we don't have time for it now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#545.dst: 對！我可以解釋給你聽，但我們現在沒時間——{u}，你得聽我說——
Echoes of Change#545.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#546.src: Sigh. You didn't need to do that. I'm not... being forced into anything, I'm just-
Echoes of Change#546.dst: 唉。你不需要那麼做。我不是……被逼的，我只是——
Echoes of Change#546.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#547.src: So you chose to work for the crown? Why?!
Echoes of Change#547.dst: 所以你是自己選擇替王室做事的？為什麼？！
Echoes of Change#547.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#548.src: I... have my reasons, trust me. Look, there's no time to explain right now- {u}, you need to listen to me-
Echoes of Change#548.dst: 我……有我的理由，相信我。聽著，現在沒時間解釋——{u}，你得聽我說——
Echoes of Change#548.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#549.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#549.dst: Sui，你在做什麼？！你這樣只會替我們招來更多注意。
Echoes of Change#549.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#551.src: If you would just let me finish... I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised- I don't know how, exactly, but we know what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#551.dst: 如果你們肯讓我把話說完……我是來警告你們的。你們這一組已經曝光了——我不確定是怎麼曝的，但我們知道你們今天打算做什麼。
Echoes of Change#551.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#553.src: It is. You need to call it off, or else-
Echoes of Change#553.dst: 是真的。你們必須取消，否則——
Echoes of Change#553.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#554.src: ... Because we're still friends, at the end of the day. I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#554.dst: ……因為說到底，我們還是朋友。我不想看你受傷。
Echoes of Change#554.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#555.src: If only you hadn't been hiding... well, it doesn't matter now. We're out of time. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#555.dst: 要是你當初沒有躲起來……嗯，現在說這些也沒用了。我們沒時間了。如果這件事之後你還平安，那……我會想辦法聯絡你。
Echoes of Change#555.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#558.src: There's... something bigger than Fruma at stake.
Echoes of Change#558.dst: 有……比 Fruma 更大的東西正押在賭桌上。
Echoes of Change#558.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#559.src: It doesn't matter. Not now, at least
Echoes of Change#559.dst: 那不重要。至少現在不重要。
Echoes of Change#559.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#560.src: Of course it matters! There's real people getting hurt by the crown, and you think it doesn't matter?!
Echoes of Change#560.dst: 當然重要！有真實的人正在被王室傷害，而你覺得那不重要？！
Echoes of Change#560.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#561.src: That's not what I said. I... we don't have time for this. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#561.dst: 我不是那個意思。我……我們沒時間談這個。{u}，你必須
Echoes of Change#561.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#563.src: I asked you not to. I don't need saving.
Echoes of Change#563.dst: 我請你不要那麼做的。我不需要被拯救。
Echoes of Change#563.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#564.src: You being here, it's... making things harder things harder than they need to be.
Echoes of Change#564.dst: 你出現在這裡，讓事情變得比原本更難、更難處理。
Echoes of Change#564.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#565.src: Harder for you?! You're the one siding with the crown, man!
Echoes of Change#565.dst: 對「你」更難？！站在王室那邊的人是你欸，老兄！
Echoes of Change#565.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#566.src: I...I don't have time for this right now. {u}, you have to
Echoes of Change#566.dst: 我……我現在真的沒時間談這個。{u}，你必須
Echoes of Change#566.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#567.src: Sui, what are you doing?! You're just going to draw more attention towards us.
Echoes of Change#567.dst: Sui，你在做什麼？！你這樣只會替我們招來更多注意。
Echoes of Change#567.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#570.src: I'm here to warn you. Your group is compromised how, exactly, I don't know, but... the Crown knowns what you're planning to do today.
Echoes of Change#570.dst: 我是來警告你們的。你們這一組已經曝光了——確切是怎麼曝的，我不知道，但……王室知道你們今天打算做什麼。
Echoes of Change#570.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#572.src: It is. Choose to believe me, or not, but
Echoes of Change#572.dst: 是真的。你要不要信我隨你，但
Echoes of Change#572.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#574.src: We're still friends, aren't we? I don't want you to get hurt.
Echoes of Change#574.dst: 我們還是朋友，不是嗎？我不想看你受傷。
Echoes of Change#574.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#575.src: If only you hadn't come after me, then... well, it doesn't matter now. You're here anyway. If you're still safe after this, then... I'll find a way to reach out to you.
Echoes of Change#575.dst: 要是你當初沒有追過來，那……嗯，現在說這些也沒用了。你人已經在這裡了。如果這件事之後你還平安，那……我會想辦法聯絡你。
Echoes of Change#575.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#576.src: Just... please, don't proceed with your plan. Find a way to stop it. I just don't want to see anyone get hurt.
Echoes of Change#576.dst: 拜託……不要執行你們的計畫。想辦法阻止它。我只是不想看到任何人受傷。
Echoes of Change#576.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#577.src: I need to go, even finding an excuse to step away for this long was difficult. Stay safe.
Echoes of Change#577.dst: 我得走了，光是找藉口離開這麼久就已經很困難。保重。
Echoes of Change#577.speaker: Sovereign Tasim

Echoes of Change#579.src: What- what do we do? We need to, to get a message out! Where's Syndra, we have to-
Echoes of Change#579.dst: 我們——我們該怎麼辦？我們得，得把消息傳出去！Syndra 在哪裡，我們得——
Echoes of Change#579.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#580.src: Oh, no... I- I don't think we can. The... the festival's starting.
Echoes of Change#580.dst: 喔，不……我、我覺得我們來不及了。慶典……慶典開始了。
Echoes of Change#580.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#582.src: Citizens of the {p}, I extend my heartfelt gratitude for your remarkable attendance this year.
Echoes of Change#582.dst: {p} 的市民們，我由衷感謝各位今年如此踴躍的出席。
Echoes of Change#582.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#583.src: Together, we shall celebrate yet another year of success and prosperity!
Echoes of Change#583.dst: 讓我們共同慶祝又一年的成功與繁榮！
Echoes of Change#583.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#584.src: Your unwavering dedication and industrious spirit are deeply valued, and I hold a profound appreciation for your contributions to the strength and glory of our province.
Echoes of Change#584.dst: 各位堅定不移的奉獻與勤奮的精神彌足珍貴，我對各位為本行省的強盛與榮光所做的貢獻深懷感激。
Echoes of Change#584.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#585.src: Production quotas for this year have been successfully achieved, and I am most pleased by this accomplishment.
Echoes of Change#585.dst: 本年度的生產配額已順利達成，我對此成果甚感欣慰。
Echoes of Change#585.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#586.src: However, as Fruma continues to evolve and flourish, it is imperative that we strive for greater heights.
Echoes of Change#586.dst: 然而，隨著 Fruma 持續發展與興盛，我們必須力求更高的境界。
Echoes of Change#586.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#587.src: As such, we shall be raising production quotas for the coming year.
Echoes of Change#587.dst: 因此，來年的生產配額將予以調升。
Echoes of Change#587.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#588.src: I have every confidence that you will continue to dedicate yourselves to the growth of Fruma.
Echoes of Change#588.dst: 我完全相信各位將繼續為 Fruma 的成長奉獻己身。
Echoes of Change#588.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#589.src: Let us now turn our attention to the year ahead, and to the improvements to the district's infrastructure that your Sovereign has prepared for your benefit.
Echoes of Change#589.dst: 現在，讓我們把目光轉向未來的一年，以及你們的統領為造福各位所準備的區內基礎建設改善。
Echoes of Change#589.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#590.src: Sovereign Soosu has been hard at work these past months, and has developed an innovative technology designed to deliver cleaner and fresher water to our people.
Echoes of Change#590.dst: Soosu 統領這幾個月來勤勉不懈，已開發出一項創新技術，將為我們的人民輸送更潔淨、更新鮮的水源。
Echoes of Change#590.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#592.src: ... I th- th- think it's time. Let's do this.
Echoes of Change#592.dst: ……我、我、我想是時候了。我們上吧。
Echoes of Change#592.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#594.src: What was that?! Soldiers, investigate the commotion!
Echoes of Change#594.dst: 那是什麼？！士兵們，去查那陣騷動！
Echoes of Change#594.speaker: Timasca Captain

Echoes of Change#595.src: Hm? Worry not for the commotion, it is already being taken care of. Now, as I was saying...
Echoes of Change#595.dst: 嗯？不必為那陣騷動憂心，已經在處理了。那麼，如我方才所言……
Echoes of Change#595.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#598.src: It's now or never... For Fruma!!!
Echoes of Change#598.dst: 此時不做，更待何時……為了 Fruma！！！
Echoes of Change#598.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#604.src: Oh, but it is. Witness, citizens, the depravity and foolhardiness of those who turn against the crown!
Echoes of Change#604.dst: 噢，但事實就是如此。市民們，見證吧——見證這些背叛王室者的墮落與愚妄！
Echoes of Change#604.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#605.src: Terrorists seeking to threaten the safety of our people, of our province! Aiding and abetting the Cursed, daring to make an attempt on my life, as your Queen!
Echoes of Change#605.dst: 威脅我們人民、威脅我們行省安全的恐怖分子！他們協助並包庇受詛者，膽敢對我這個你們的女王行刺！
Echoes of Change#605.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#606.src: We are furtunate that news of their plot reached the crown, and that our Sovereign Soosu could devise a construct to deceive them, to draw them out into the open.
Echoes of Change#606.dst: 所幸他們的陰謀走漏到了王室耳中，而我們的 Soosu 統領得以造出一具構裝來欺瞞他們，將他們引誘現身。
Echoes of Change#606.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#607.src: Sovereigns, soldiers, to arms! Hunt down any terrorists or supporters you can find!
Echoes of Change#607.dst: 統領們、士兵們，備戰！把你們找得到的恐怖分子與支持者全數獵捕！
Echoes of Change#607.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#608.src: I should have expected you'd have some tricks left.
Echoes of Change#608.dst: 我早該料到你還留了幾手。
Echoes of Change#608.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#609.src: Oh, Syndra... you couldn't just stay put and leave things to rest, could you? To discard your safety, security... all for this?
Echoes of Change#609.dst: 噢，Syndra……你就不能安分待著、讓事情過去嗎？拋棄你的安全、你的保障……全都為了這個？
Echoes of Change#609.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#610.src: I once saw great potential in you. Your strategic mind, your dedication... a pity you had to throw it all away.
Echoes of Change#610.dst: 我曾在你身上看到極大的潛力。你的戰略頭腦、你的奉獻……可惜你把這一切都扔掉了。
Echoes of Change#610.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#611.src: Did you really believe it would be that easy to kill me? A single empowered strike? Have you forgotten who gave you that blessing in the first place?!
Echoes of Change#611.dst: 你真以為殺我會那麼容易嗎？區區一記強化過的攻擊？你忘了當初是誰賜你那份祝福的嗎？！
Echoes of Change#611.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#612.src: What a shame, that your rage and desperation blinded you to the truth. You never stood a chance.
Echoes of Change#612.dst: 何其可惜，你的憤怒與絕望蒙蔽了你，讓你看不見真相。你從來就毫無勝算。
Echoes of Change#612.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#613.src: No... no, no, no... what do we do?!
Echoes of Change#613.dst: 不……不、不、不……我們該怎麼辦？！
Echoes of Change#613.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#614.src: Damn it... we need to stick to the plan. Take the escape routes and regroup.
Echoes of Change#614.dst: 該死……我們得照計畫走。走撤離路線，然後會合。
Echoes of Change#614.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#615.src: What?! We can't just leave her behind! We, we have to help her! She's... I can't lose her.
Echoes of Change#615.dst: 什麼？！我們不能就這樣丟下她！我們，我們得去幫她！她是……我不能失去她。
Echoes of Change#615.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#616.src: I know, I know! But... she knew this might happen. She told us to save ourselves first if anything goes wrong.
Echoes of Change#616.dst: 我知道，我知道！可是……她知道這可能會發生。她說過如果出了任何差錯，我們要先保住自己。
Echoes of Change#616.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#617.src: Besides, we... what could we even do? If Syndra can't kill her, what could we possibly do? Can't you feel it? This... this pressure?
Echoes of Change#617.dst: 何況，我們……我們又能做什麼？如果連 Syndra 都殺不了她，我們可能做什麼？你感覺不到嗎？這……這股壓迫感？
Echoes of Change#617.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#618.src: Is... is that coming from her? I, I felt something similar, during the Auburn festival...
Echoes of Change#618.dst: 那……那是從她身上來的嗎？我，我在 Auburn 慶典的時候也感覺過類似的東西……
Echoes of Change#618.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#619.src: She's furious... we need to get out of here. Quickly, let's head for the underground river escape route!
Echoes of Change#619.dst: 她震怒了……我們得離開這裡。快，我們走地下河那條撤離路線！
Echoes of Change#619.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#620.src: Escape using the underground river at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#621.src: How is this possible? Why are there, ha, guards stationed here?!
Echoes of Change#621.dst: 這怎麼可能？為什麼，哈，這裡會有衛兵駐守？！
Echoes of Change#621.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#622.src: I- I don't know! They must have done some last minute schedule changes, or... or...
Echoes of Change#622.dst: 我、我不知道！他們一定是臨時改了排班，或者……或者……
Echoes of Change#622.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#623.src: Oh. Or they knew our whole plan. Ha... hahaha, we never stood a chance!
Echoes of Change#623.dst: 喔。或者他們早就知道我們整個計畫。哈……哈哈哈，我們從來就毫無勝算！
Echoes of Change#623.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#624.src: What are we going to do now? Yusanu, where's the next closest escape route?
Echoes of Change#624.dst: 我們現在該怎麼辦？Yusanu，最近的下一條撤離路線在哪？
Echoes of Change#624.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#625.src: WE HAVE VOICES OVER BY THE CAMP SITE!! Requesting backup!
Echoes of Change#625.dst: 營地那邊有人聲！！請求支援！
Echoes of Change#625.speaker: Timasca Soldier

Echoes of Change#626.src: Ugh, there's more voices to the west! That mean the only route left is... is... oh, no.
Echoes of Change#626.dst: 唉，西邊也有人聲！那代表只剩下一條路了……是……喔，不。
Echoes of Change#626.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#629.src: What?! That'll just take us even further into danger!
Echoes of Change#629.dst: 什麼？！那只會把我們帶進更深的危險裡！
Echoes of Change#629.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#630.src: Yeah, I know! But it's our only option left! We'll... we'll figure it out. Come on!
Echoes of Change#630.dst: 對，我知道！可是那是我們僅剩的選項了！我們……我們會想出辦法的。走吧！
Echoes of Change#630.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#631.src: Escape using the Redwood gate at [-{~}, {~}, {~}].

Echoes of Change#633.src: Hey! We need to get out, now!
Echoes of Change#633.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#634.src: There's... barely any guards around. Zeph and Yuman must've really succeeded...
Echoes of Change#634.dst: 這裡……幾乎沒有衛兵。Zeph 和 Yuman 一定是真的成功了……
Echoes of Change#634.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#635.src: ...hold it. Something's wrong. They would never leave the gate unguarded...
Echoes of Change#635.dst: ……等等。不對勁。他們絕不可能讓這道門沒人看守……
Echoes of Change#635.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#636.dst: 我們……我們是不是該掉頭？
Echoes of Change#636.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#637.src: You're right. We wouldn't be that obtuse. But you were.
Echoes of Change#637.dst: 你說得對。我們不會那麼遲鈍。但你們是。

Echoes of Change#640.src: I'll hand it to you, those were some unexpected variables you introduced for this plan of yours, but you should know how good I am at crunching the numbers.
Echoes of Change#640.dst: 我承認，你們替這個計畫引入了一些出乎意料的變數，但你們該知道我多擅長算數。
Echoes of Change#640.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#641.src: More to the point... YOU. Cursed. You just keep summing to your list of crimes! There's the Torann massacre, we can add every other soldier to the tally... And...the death of a Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#641.dst: 更重要的是——「你」。受詛者。你的罪狀還在不斷累加！有 Torann 屠殺，再把其餘每一個士兵都計進去……還有……一位統領之死。
Echoes of Change#641.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#642.src: Let me ask. Do you know how it feels to die? Disposed of like yesterday's garbage? Do you know how exponentially more excruciating it is to feel IN REVERSE?!
Echoes of Change#642.dst: 我問你。你知道死是什麼感覺嗎？像昨天的垃圾一樣被丟棄？你知道「反過來」感受那件事，會痛苦到什麼樣的指數級嗎？！
Echoes of Change#642.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#643.src: If dealing with you quickly wasn't magnitudes of order more important, I'd give you a lesson on the topic. Consider yourself lucky, cursed!
Echoes of Change#643.dst: 要不是儘快解決你重要了好幾個數量級，我倒真想給你上一課。算你走運，受詛的！
Echoes of Change#643.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#644.src: What... what's going to happen with Syndra?
Echoes of Change#644.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#645.src: ...an attempt on Her Majesty's life carries high consequences. Almost positive she'll be divided out...but that isn't my problem to solve.
Echoes of Change#645.dst: ……行刺女王陛下的代價極高。我幾乎可以肯定她會被除掉……但那不是我要解的題。
Echoes of Change#645.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#646.src: Weren't you... weren't you friends?! And you're just, going to let-
Echoes of Change#646.dst: 你們……你們不是朋友嗎？！而你就這樣，任由——
Echoes of Change#646.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#647.src: NOT ONE MORE FACTORING WORD! How much do you think I enjoy this?! Do you think I want to hunt her down like a forgotten variable?!
Echoes of Change#647.dst: 一個該分解的字都不准再說！你以為我很享受這件事嗎？！你以為我想像追捕一個被遺忘的變數那樣去追捕她嗎？！
Echoes of Change#647.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#648.src: She chose to terminate our sequence! She threw that all away, used me for some irrational solution! She has as much value as any of you zeroes now!
Echoes of Change#648.dst: 是她選擇終止我們這個數列的！是她把那一切都扔掉，拿我去換某個不理性的解！她現在跟你們這些零一樣沒有價值！
Echoes of Change#648.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#649.src: So why don't we accelerate this? Without that traitor misusing her blessing... Your number's up!!
Echoes of Change#649.dst: 所以我們何不加速一下？沒有那個叛徒濫用她的祝福……你的數到頭了！！
Echoes of Change#649.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#651.src: I... I think I'm gonna be sick...
Echoes of Change#651.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#652.src: He's... he's dead. Again. We beat him... again.
Echoes of Change#652.dst: 他……他死了。又一次。我們又……打贏他了。
Echoes of Change#652.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#653.src: Again?! So he was being literal about you killing him before?
Echoes of Change#653.dst: 又一次？！所以他說你以前殺過他，是照字面上的意思？
Echoes of Change#653.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#654.src: ... Okay. Okay, so... probably not down for good. Great! That's just... great.
Echoes of Change#654.dst: ……好。好吧，所以……大概還不算徹底解決。太好了！那真是……太好了。
Echoes of Change#654.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#656.src: I... I don't, um, have enough mana left to fight, anymore... s-so we should leave, before-
Echoes of Change#656.dst: 我……我的魔力，嗯，不夠再打了……所、所以我們該走了，趁——
Echoes of Change#656.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#657.src: Uh... y- yeah, we should... get moving.
Echoes of Change#657.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#658.dst: ……唔啊啊啊！！我們的……數列……不會終止……直到你先終止！！
Echoes of Change#658.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#659.src: H- how...? It, it took him way longer, last time...
Echoes of Change#659.dst: 怎、怎麼會……？上、上次他花的時間長多了……
Echoes of Change#659.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#660.src: Nngh... You...miscalculated! I told you! You know how good I am at crunching the numbers! I prepared...hhhff...for this possibility!
Echoes of Change#660.dst: 唔……你……算錯了！我就跟你說了！你知道我多擅長算數！我早就……呼……為這個可能性做了準備！
Echoes of Change#660.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#661.src: It was a calculated risk. Overloading the old Nasin charm... That could've broken it. But instead...my expected solution is here!
Echoes of Change#661.dst: 那是經過計算的風險。讓 Nasin 家那枚老符咒過載……那可能會弄壞它。但結果……我期望的解就在這裡！
Echoes of Change#661.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#662.src: A near-instant revival! And I heard your collaborator- All out of power now. I nearly had you in round one, even. Fight all you want- it'll sum to nothing, murderer!
Echoes of Change#662.dst: 近乎瞬間的復活！而且我聽到你的同夥了——現在完全沒力氣了。第一回合我就差點拿下你們。要打就打吧——總和仍然會是零，兇手！
Echoes of Change#662.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#664.src: ...Soosu. Thank you for taking me seriously. I didn't want you involved for the danger, but with both of us... We'll solve this problem in no time. Follow my le-
Echoes of Change#664.dst: ……Soosu。謝謝你把我的話當回事。我本來不想讓你涉險，但有我們兩個……我們很快就能解掉這個問題。跟著我的——
Echoes of Change#664.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#665.src: GAAAH!! S-SOOSU?! You... What was...?! Nnh...
Echoes of Change#665.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#666.src: Soosu!! Th-These are the insurgents! The murderers!! You can't be- What did they- WHAT ARE YOU HOLDING OVER HER?! Soosu, I swear, you can get out of-
Echoes of Change#666.dst: Soosu！！這些是叛亂分子！是兇手！！你不可能——他們對你做了——你到底拿什麼要脅她？！Soosu，我發誓，你可以脫身——
Echoes of Change#666.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#667.src: Yeah, yeah... I know. But I think I'm sick and tired of trying.
Echoes of Change#667.dst: 是啊，是啊……我知道。但我想我已經受夠再試下去了。
Echoes of Change#667.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#668.src: ...Soosu...you can't- I know you can be better, you can- I'll-
Echoes of Change#668.dst: ……Soosu……你不能——我知道你可以更好，你可以——我會——
Echoes of Change#668.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#669.src: It'll all be over soon, Z. Please... don't make me kill you again.
Echoes of Change#669.dst: 很快就會結束了，Z。拜託……別逼我再殺你一次。
Echoes of Change#669.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#671.src: Why- why are you helping us?
Echoes of Change#671.dst: 為什麼——你為什麼要幫我們？
Echoes of Change#671.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#672.src: Just... go, Yus. You're wasting time.
Echoes of Change#672.dst: 你就……走吧，Yus。你在浪費時間。
Echoes of Change#672.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#673.src: But... I was the one who stole your project. Why would you...
Echoes of Change#673.dst: 可是……偷走你那個計畫的人是我。你為什麼會……
Echoes of Change#673.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#674.src: Yes, Yus, I know! What does it matter why I'm helping you? Just... just take it and go. Before they realize you're here.
Echoes of Change#674.dst: 對，Yus，我知道！我為什麼幫你們有什麼重要的？就……就拿著它走。趁他們還沒發現你在這裡。
Echoes of Change#674.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#676.src: Ugh, why are you so-! Fine! You - when I look at you, it's like I'm looking at myself, before... before I became this.
Echoes of Change#676.dst: 唉，你為什麼這麼——！好吧！你——我看著你的時候，就像在看我自己，在……在我變成這樣之前。
Echoes of Change#676.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#677.src: Now, go! Run! Flee! Just, leave!
Echoes of Change#677.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#678.src: If... If I leave you here. You, you-
Echoes of Change#678.dst: 如果……如果我把你留在這裡。你、你會——
Echoes of Change#678.speaker: Yusanu

Echoes of Change#679.src: I'll be okay, Yusanu, I'm tired of fighting. I'm tired of my duty. I'm sick of this life.
Echoes of Change#679.dst: 我不會有事的，Yusanu，我厭倦戰鬥了。我厭倦我的職責。我受夠了這種人生。
Echoes of Change#679.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#681.src: We... we need to go, Yusanu.
Echoes of Change#681.speaker: Sui

Echoes of Change#683.src: Well then, Syndra the Lioness. Nothing to say in response? Has a cat got your tongue?
Echoes of Change#683.dst: 那麼，母獅 Syndra。沒有話要回應嗎？被貓咬了舌頭？
Echoes of Change#683.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#684.src: I have no words for you.
Echoes of Change#684.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#685.src: No, I suppose you were always more fond of the language of violence...
Echoes of Change#685.dst: 也是，我想你一向更偏愛暴力這種語言……
Echoes of Change#685.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#686.src: You'll notice the area has been cleared. You understand what this means for you, yes?
Echoes of Change#686.dst: 你會注意到這片區域已經清空了。你明白這對你意味著什麼吧？
Echoes of Change#686.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#687.src: The same as always. I kill you, or I die trying.
Echoes of Change#687.dst: 跟以往一樣。我殺了你，或者我死在嘗試的路上。
Echoes of Change#687.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#688.src: Yuman... We n- n- need to find an escape route that w- wor- works!
Echoes of Change#688.dst: Yuman……我們得、得找到一條走、走得通的撤離路線！
Echoes of Change#688.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#689.src: Ugh, there are way more guards than we expected! We'll have to find a way to dodge them all...
Echoes of Change#689.dst: 唉，衛兵比我們預期的多太多了！我們得想辦法全部避開……
Echoes of Change#689.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#691.src: I ca- ca- can't stand this... not h- hel- helping Syndra!
Echoes of Change#691.dst: 我受、受不了這樣……幫、幫不上 Syndra！
Echoes of Change#691.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#692.src: Hey, man, have faith. She'll find a way out of there! But for now, we've gotta worry 'bout ourselves, 'kay?
Echoes of Change#692.dst: 嘿，老兄，有點信心。她會想辦法脫身的！但現在，我們得先顧好自己，好嗎？
Echoes of Change#692.speaker: Yuman

Echoes of Change#693.src: Yeah... th- thanks, Yuman. Let's k- ke- keep moving.
Echoes of Change#693.dst: 嗯……謝了，Yuman。我們繼、繼續走吧。
Echoes of Change#693.speaker: Zeph

Echoes of Change#694.src: Behold, citizens... the face of the insurgent group.
Echoes of Change#694.dst: 市民們，看好了……這就是叛亂集團的面目。
Echoes of Change#694.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#695.src: The two cursed ones who attacked us have been captured. However, there are still people out there who wish us harm. Please, stay on high alert!
Echoes of Change#695.dst: 襲擊我們的那兩名受詛者已經落網。然而，外頭仍有想加害我們的人。請保持高度警戒！
Echoes of Change#695.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#696.src: If you notice any suspicious behaviour, contact your local military. Together, we will prevail as a nation.
Echoes of Change#696.dst: 若察覺任何可疑行為，請聯繫當地駐軍。同心協力，我們作為一個國家必將獲勝。
Echoes of Change#696.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#697.src: But do not worry. Even such an aggressive assault from the enemy stood no chance against our might. I will ensure everyone's safety!
Echoes of Change#697.dst: 但不必憂慮。即使是敵人如此猛烈的攻勢，在我們的威能面前也毫無勝算。我會確保每一個人的安全！
Echoes of Change#697.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#698.src: Now. As punishment for attempting to assassinate me... I will execute Syndra, leader of the cursed terrorists, right here!
Echoes of Change#698.dst: 現在。作為行刺我的懲罰……我將在此處決受詛恐怖分子的首領 Syndra！
Echoes of Change#698.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#699.src: Her accomplice will be imprisoned and questioned for information on the remaining insurgents.
Echoes of Change#699.dst: 她的同夥將被監禁並接受審訊，以取得其餘叛亂分子的情報。
Echoes of Change#699.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#702.src: I don't regret anything I've done. I know Fruma will change for the better. Maybe not today, or tomorrow! But change will come.
Echoes of Change#702.dst: 我對自己做過的一切毫無悔意。我知道 Fruma 會往好的方向改變。也許不是今天，也不是明天！但改變終將到來。
Echoes of Change#702.speaker: Syndra

Echoes of Change#703.src: I regret that it had to come to this, Syndra... I draw no joy from your death. I wonder, whatever happened to that woman who held boundless potential within?
Echoes of Change#703.dst: 我遺憾事情非得走到這一步，Syndra……我從你的死亡中得不到任何喜悅。我不禁想，那個曾經懷抱無限潛力的女子，究竟怎麼了？
Echoes of Change#703.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#705.src: I will find your children, Syndra. This tantrum of yours ends here with you.
Echoes of Change#705.dst: 我會找到你的孩子們，Syndra。你這場鬧脾氣就在你身上終結。
Echoes of Change#705.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#706.src: Now, as for those Sovereigns of mine...
Echoes of Change#706.dst: 現在，至於我那幾位統領……
Echoes of Change#706.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#707.src: I know you, Soosu. Please, tell me what's wrong! This isn't an unsolvable problem! Don't make it so I lose two of my-
Echoes of Change#707.dst: 我了解你，Soosu。拜託，告訴我出了什麼事！這不是一道無解的題！別讓我一口氣失去兩個我的——
Echoes of Change#707.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#708.src: Sovereign Zhiraok. I cannot help but notice the obvious lack of captured terrorists, amidst the scene of a battle.
Echoes of Change#708.dst: Zhiraok 統領。我不禁注意到，在這片戰鬥的現場，明顯少了被捕的恐怖分子。
Echoes of Change#708.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#709.src: Your Majesty!! The insurgents, they must have blackmailed Sovereign Soosu, she-
Echoes of Change#709.dst: 陛下！！那些叛亂分子，他們一定是要脅了 Soosu 統領，她——
Echoes of Change#709.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#710.src: Silence. You have failed me twice, now. They have bested you in combat twice, Sovereign.
Echoes of Change#710.dst: 住口。你已經令我失望兩次了。他們在戰鬥中勝過你兩次，統領。
Echoes of Change#710.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#711.src: I- The cursed have greater cunning than I cal-
Echoes of Change#711.dst: 我——受詛者的狡詐超出我的估——
Echoes of Change#711.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#712.src: I am disappointed in your performance. You are now expressly forbidden from continuing to chase and track down these... rotten children.
Echoes of Change#712.dst: 我對你的表現很失望。從現在起，明令禁止你再繼續追捕這些……敗壞的孩子。
Echoes of Change#712.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#713.src: ...I. ... ...I alone take full responsibility for this failure, Your Majesty. Bu-
Echoes of Change#713.dst: ……我。……我獨自為這次失敗承擔全部責任，陛下。但——
Echoes of Change#713.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#714.src: Focus yourself on maintaining {p} operations in the absence of its Sovereign, would you? You have much experience already, I'm sure.
Echoes of Change#714.dst: 在 {p} 統領缺位期間，你就把心思放在維持該地運作上，好嗎？我相信你在這方面已經很有經驗了。
Echoes of Change#714.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#716.src: Now, stop standing there, and do something! Rally the soldiers, track down the remnants of that terrorist group still hiding!
Echoes of Change#716.dst: 現在，別杵在那裡，去做點事！集合士兵，把那個恐怖組織仍在藏匿的殘餘分子追捕出來！
Echoes of Change#716.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#719.src: As for you... do you think your little games will spare you from my wrath? Attacking a fellow Sovereign, allowing these targets to escape...
Echoes of Change#719.dst: 至於你……你以為你那些小把戲能讓你逃過我的怒火嗎？攻擊同僚統領、放走這些目標……
Echoes of Change#719.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#720.src: Bla, bla, whatever. Just get it over with. Kill me already, if I'm so worthless to you.
Echoes of Change#720.dst: 廢話、廢話，隨便啦。快點結束吧。如果我對你這麼沒價值，就殺了我啊。
Echoes of Change#720.speaker: Sovereign Soosu

Echoes of Change#721.src: And allow you a peaceful death? After I gave you everything, and you turned around and betrayed me?!
Echoes of Change#721.dst: 還讓你得到一個安詳的死？在我給了你一切，而你轉頭背叛我之後？！
Echoes of Change#721.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#722.src: No, Soosu. You deserve no such mercy from me.
Echoes of Change#722.dst: 不，Soosu。你不配得到我這樣的慈悲。
Echoes of Change#722.speaker: Her Majesty

Echoes of Change#723.src: ...every last factoring person down here is charged with conspiracy. Her Majesty demands their capture, by any and all means.
Echoes of Change#723.dst: ……下面每一個該分解的人都以共謀罪論處。陛下要求將他們全數逮捕，不擇任何手段。
Echoes of Change#723.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok

Echoes of Change#724.src: Get it done. Now. One of them must know what they did to Soo- ... I'll be questioning each of them. Personally.
Echoes of Change#724.dst: 去辦。現在。他們之中一定有人知道他們對 Soo——……每一個我都會親自審問。
Echoes of Change#724.speaker: Sovereign Zhiraok
